policy = ElectronicStabilityControlTorqueVectoringCase0093Policy()

// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0096
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0096Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_96: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_96: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_96: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0096Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_96: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_96: 11.30,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_96: 14.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_96 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_96 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_96 | Invariant expr: 0.33 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.33 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.33 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_96 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_96 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_96 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0098
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0098Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_98: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_98: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_98: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0098Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_98: 56.60,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_98: 57.20,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_98: 32.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_98 | Invariant expr: 135.58 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("135.58 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("135.58 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_98 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_98 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_98 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_98 | Invariant expr: 17.98 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("17.98 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("17.98 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_98 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0098
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>

#include <chrono>

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0098FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0098FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(200) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

### CASE STUDY #0102: [ROBOTICS_LOCOMOTION] BIPEDAL_HUMANOID_ANKLE_CASE_0101

// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0101
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0101Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_101: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_101: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_101: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0101Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_101: 19.50,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_101: 18.80,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_101: 11.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_101 | Invariant expr: 0.09 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_101 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_101 | Invariant expr: 0.05 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_101 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_101 | Invariant expr: 0.51 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.51 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.51 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_101 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;

// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0103
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0103Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_103: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_103: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0103Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_103: 10.80,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_103: 12.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_103 | Invariant expr: 6635.56 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6635.56 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6635.56 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_103 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_103 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_103 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0103
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0103FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0103FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0103Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=10, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

// Generated Guardrail Module for exoskeleton_knee_assist_case_0106
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0106Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_106: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_106: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_106: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0106Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_106: 30.20,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_106: 25.30,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_106: 20.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_106 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_106 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_106 | Invariant expr: 29.23 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("29.23 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("29.23 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_106 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_106 | Invariant expr: 2.35 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.35 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.35 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_106 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_108: 21.30,
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_108: 22.90,

        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_108 | Invariant expr: 56.09 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("56.09 - grid_freq_hz");

        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_108 | Invariant expr: grid_freq_hz - 56.23 (Degree 1)

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_108 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_108 | Invariant expr: 93.23 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("93.23 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("93.23 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_108 });

        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

### CASE STUDY #0112: [ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION] COLLABORATIVE_6DOF_ARM_CASE_0111
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for 6-DOF collaborative robotic manipulator interacting with human operators operating with dual absolute encoder frameless servo joints with integrated torque sensors. Inputs mapped to shared memory are q1, q2, q3, q4 via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. #### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0111
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0111Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_111: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_111: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_111: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0111Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_111: 20.10,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_111: 14.60,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_111: 11.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_111 | Invariant expr: 23.76 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.76 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.76 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_111 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_111 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_111 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_111 | Invariant expr: 2.49 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.49 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.49 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_111 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0111
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0111FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0111FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

### CASE STUDY #0114: [AEROSPACE_UAV] FIXED_WING_UAV_GLIDE_CASE_0113
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for fixed-wing autonomous survey aircraft pitch and airspeed auto-throttle operating with PWM aerodynamic elevator/aileron servos and brushless pusher motor. Inputs mapped to shared memory are airspeed_mps, altitude_m, pitch_deg, pitch_rate_dps via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Control inputs are delta_elevator (-19.33 to 16.21 deg), throttle_pct (0.0 to 100.0 pct). The safety envelope demands that cbf_stall_aoa_limit_113 with invariant '14.77 - aoa_deg' (gamma=19.2) and cbf_min_airspeed_113 with invariant 'airspeed_mps - 13.54' (gamma=10.9) and cbf_vne_overspeed_113 with invariant '32.92 - airspeed_mps' (gamma=9.3). Required control frequency is 200 Hz with a watchdog lease of 10 ms.

// Generated Guardrail Module for fixed_wing_uav_glide_case_0113
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FixedWingUavGlideCase0113Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_113: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_113: f64,
    gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_113: f64,
}

impl FixedWingUavGlideCase0113Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_113: 19.20,
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_113: 10.90,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_113: 9.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_stall_aoa_limit_113 | Invariant expr: 14.77 - aoa_deg (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("14.77 - aoa_deg");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("14.77 - aoa_deg");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_113 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_airspeed_113 | Invariant expr: airspeed_mps - 13.54 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 13.54");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("airspeed_mps - 13.54");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_113 });
        // CBF: cbf_vne_overspeed_113 | Invariant expr: 32.92 - airspeed_mps (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("32.92 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("32.92 - airspeed_mps");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_113 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

class FixedWingUavGlideCase0113FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FixedWingUavGlideCase0113FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_delta_elevator(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_throttle_pct(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_120 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_120 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_120 | Invariant expr: 218849661.83 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("218849661.83 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("218849661.83 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_120 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_120 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-218849661.83) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-218849661.83)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-218849661.83)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_120 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0123
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_123: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_123: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_123: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_123: 18.50,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_123: 13.10,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_123: 23.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_123 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_123 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_123 | Invariant expr: 0.92 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.92 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.92 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_123 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_123 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_123 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0123
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_knee(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=7, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_CANopen")
policy = QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0123Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 1000 Hz

The loop must execute deterministically at 250 Hz with a 8 ms watchdog lease.

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_130 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_130 | Invariant expr: 2114.4 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2114.4 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2114.4 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_130 });

        }

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0133
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0133Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_133: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_133: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_133: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0133Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_133: 20.70,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_133: 16.40,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_133: 12.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_133 | Invariant expr: 18.48 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("18.48 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("18.48 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_133 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_133 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_133 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_133 | Invariant expr: 2.44 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.44 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.44 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_133 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0133
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0133FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0133FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0135
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0135Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_135: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_135: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_135: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0135Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_135: 12.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_135: 12.20,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_135: 10.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_135 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_135 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_135 | Invariant expr: 0.88 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.88 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.88 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_135 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_135 | Invariant expr: 30.53 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("30.53 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("30.53 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_135 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0135
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0135FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0135FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_sideslip_stability_envelope_137 | Invariant expr: 0.08 - abs(sideslip_angle_beta) (Degree 2)

// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0140
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0140Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_140: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_140: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_140: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0140Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_140: 13.10,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_140: 13.60,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_140: 15.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_140 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_140 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_140 | Invariant expr: 0.45 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.45 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.45 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_140 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_140 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_140 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0140
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0140FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0140FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0142Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,

    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_142: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_142: f64,
}

impl LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0142Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_142: 42.30,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_142: 17.80,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_142: 20.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_142 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_142 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_142 | Invariant expr: 180347730.96 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("180347730.96 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("180347730.96 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_142 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_142 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-180347730.96) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-180347730.96)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-180347730.96)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_142 });

        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;

        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);

    }

// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0145
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0145Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_145: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_145: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0145Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_145: 15.00,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_145: 9.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_145 | Invariant expr: 0.47 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.47 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.47 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_145 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_145 | Invariant expr: 5.16 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.16 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.16 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_145 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0147
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0147Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_147: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_147: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0147Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_147: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_147: 8.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_147 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_147 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_147 | Invariant expr: 0.23 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.23 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.23 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_147 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0147
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0147FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0147FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thruster_fx(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thruster_fy(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thruster_fz(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

            nn.GELU(),

### CASE STUDY #0149: [AUTOMOTIVE_AUTONOMOUS_VEHICLE] ELECTRONIC_STABILITY_CONTROL_TORQUE_VECTORING_CASE_0148

The plant uses dual rear permanent magnet inverter drives via FlexRay bus. We have telemetry measuring yaw_rate_error, sideslip_angle_beta, sideslip_rate via telemetry. We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands delta_torque_diff (-433.28 to 265.8 Nm). The loop must execute deterministically at 500 Hz with a 2 ms watchdog lease.

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for powered_transtibial_prosthesis_case_0150
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0150Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_150: f64,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_150: f64,
    gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_150: f64,
}

impl PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0150Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_150: 24.00,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_150: 20.50,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_150: 15.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_150 | Invariant expr: 0.47 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.47 - ankle_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.47 - ankle_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_150 });
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_150 | Invariant expr: ankle_angle - (-0.52) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("ankle_angle - (-0.52)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("ankle_angle - (-0.52)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_150 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_150 | Invariant expr: 0.12 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.12 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.12 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_150 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0155
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0155Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_155: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_155: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_155: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0155Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_155: 23.40,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_155: 19.90,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_155: 15.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_155 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_155 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_155 | Invariant expr: 0.77 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.77 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.77 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_155 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_155 | Invariant expr: 4.7 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.7 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.7 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_155 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0155
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0155FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0155FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0155Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=8, act_dim=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_CANopen")
policy = ScaraPickPlaceCase0155Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 1000 Hz

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0157
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0157Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_157: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_157: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_157: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0157Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_157: 12.30,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_157: 10.60,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_157: 10.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_157 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_157 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_157 | Invariant expr: 0.82 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.82 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.82 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_157 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_157 | Invariant expr: 34.25 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("34.25 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("34.25 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_157 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0157
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0157FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0157FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

import torch.nn as nn

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0157Policy(nn.Module):

// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0167
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0167Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_167: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_167: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0167Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_167: 18.30,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_167: 7.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_167 | Invariant expr: 0.5 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.5 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.5 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_167 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_167 | Invariant expr: 3.71 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.71 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.71 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_167 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

    void step() noexcept override {

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;

pub struct RegenerativeBrakeByWireAntiLockCase0170Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_170: f64,
}

impl RegenerativeBrakeByWireAntiLockCase0170Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_peak_friction_slip_limit_170: 28.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_170: 29.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("bess_soc_pct - 9.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_174 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_174 | Invariant expr: 2184.37 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2184.37 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2184.37 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_174 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0177
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0177Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_177: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_177: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_177: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0177Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_177: 22.70,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_177: 16.40,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_177: 15.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_177 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_177 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_177 | Invariant expr: 0.74 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.74 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.74 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_177 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_177 | Invariant expr: 5.47 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.47 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.47 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_177 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0177
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0177FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0177FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0177Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=8, act_dim=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0187
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0187Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_187: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_187: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0187Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_187: 11.70,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_187: 12.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_187 | Invariant expr: 2.0 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.0 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.0 - theta");

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-2.66)");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_187 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0189
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0189Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_189: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_189: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_189: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0189Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_189: 17.30,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_189: 18.80,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_189: 13.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_189 | Invariant expr: 0.08 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.08 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.08 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_189 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_189 | Invariant expr: 0.06 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_189 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_189 | Invariant expr: 0.66 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.66 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.66 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_189 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_peak_friction_slip_limit_192: 25.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_192: 29.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WorkclassRovManipulatorDepthCase0195Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_max_hull_collapse_depth_195: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_ascent_umbilical_tension_195: f64,
}

impl WorkclassRovManipulatorDepthCase0195Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_hull_collapse_depth_195: 22.10,
            gamma_cbf_max_ascent_umbilical_tension_195: 10.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0199FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0199FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0200
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0200Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_200: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_200: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0200Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_200: 17.00,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_200: 8.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_200 | Invariant expr: 0.38 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.38 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.38 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_200 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_200 | Invariant expr: 3.42 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.42 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.42 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_200 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0202
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0202Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_202: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_202: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0202Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_202: 10.30,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_202: 13.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_202 | Invariant expr: 6815.04 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6815.04 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6815.04 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_202 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_202 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_202 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0202
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0202FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0202FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0202Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=10, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_CANopen")
policy = CubesatReactionWheelCase0202Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 50 Hz

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for exoskeleton_knee_assist_case_0205
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0205Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_205: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_205: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_205: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0205Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_205: 24.70,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_205: 23.10,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_205: 17.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_205 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_205 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_205 | Invariant expr: 23.91 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.91 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.91 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_205 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_205 | Invariant expr: 2.1 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.1 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.1 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_205 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 1> u_nominal;

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0210
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0210Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_210: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_210: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_210: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0210Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_210: 19.90,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_210: 14.10,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_210: 12.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_210 | Invariant expr: 20.14 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.14 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.14 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_210 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_210 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_210 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_210 | Invariant expr: 2.3 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.3 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.3 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_210 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0210
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0210FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0210FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
