### CASE STUDY #0212: [ROBOTICS_LOCOMOTION] QUADRUPED_LEG_IMPEDANCE_CASE_0211
**Application Context**: Configure Shiva.ai middleware for a 3-DOF quadruped robot single leg high-dynamic impedance controller. System telemetry streams q_hip, q_thigh, q_shank, dq_hip via telemetry. Our primary objective is stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation is handled via tau_hip (-17.97 to 24.76 Nm), tau_thigh (-29.5 to 37.93 Nm), tau_knee (-26.2 to 39.94 Nm). Hard safety guarantees must be enforced by the GuardrailNode: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_211 with invariant 'q_shank - 0.15' (gamma=19.8) and cbf_hip_overtravel_211 with invariant '0.86 - abs(q_hip)' (gamma=14.2) and cbf_ground_penetration_211 with invariant 'foot_pos_z - ground_height' (gamma=21.9). Run the real-time loop at 1000 Hz with a fail-safe watchdog of 2 ms.

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fixed_wing_uav_glide_case_0212
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FixedWingUavGlideCase0212Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_212: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_212: f64,
    gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_212: f64,
}

impl FixedWingUavGlideCase0212Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_212: 18.60,
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_212: 12.90,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_212: 10.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_stall_aoa_limit_212 | Invariant expr: 14.02 - aoa_deg (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("14.02 - aoa_deg");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("14.02 - aoa_deg");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_212 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_airspeed_212 | Invariant expr: airspeed_mps - 12.6 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 12.6");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("airspeed_mps - 12.6");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_212 });
        // CBF: cbf_vne_overspeed_212 | Invariant expr: 38.41 - airspeed_mps (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("38.41 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("38.41 - airspeed_mps");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_212 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

// FastDecisionNode implementation for fixed_wing_uav_glide_case_0212
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class FixedWingUavGlideCase0212FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FixedWingUavGlideCase0212FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_delta_elevator(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_throttle_pct(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0222
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0222Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_222: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_222: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_222: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0222Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_222: 19.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_222: 14.90,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_222: 25.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_222 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_222 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_222 | Invariant expr: 1.15 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.15 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.15 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_222 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_222 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_222 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0222
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0222FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0222FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_knee(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_227: 23.30,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_227: 21.50,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_227: 20.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0230
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0230Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_230: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_230: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_230: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0230Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_230: 50.90,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_230: 49.80,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_230: 34.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_230 | Invariant expr: 141.15 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("141.15 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("141.15 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_230 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_230 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_230 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_230 | Invariant expr: 16.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("16.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("16.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_230 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0232
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0232Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_232: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_232: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_232: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0232Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_232: 18.70,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_232: 16.50,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_232: 13.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_232 | Invariant expr: 15.69 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("15.69 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("15.69 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_232 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_232 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_232 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_232 | Invariant expr: 2.14 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.14 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.14 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_232 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0232
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0232FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0232FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0232Policy(nn.Module):

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),

// Generated Guardrail Module for steam_boiler_drum_level_3element_case_0237
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0237Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_237: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_237: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_237: f64,
}

impl SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0237Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_237: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_237: 11.60,
            gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_237: 21.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_237 | Invariant expr: 192.8 - drum_level_mm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("192.8 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("192.8 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_237 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_237 | Invariant expr: drum_level_mm - (-196.5) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("drum_level_mm - (-196.5)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("drum_level_mm - (-196.5)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_237 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_237 | Invariant expr: 165.0 - drum_pressure_bar (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_237 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_241 | Invariant expr: 18.35 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("18.35 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("18.35 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_241 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

    gamma_cbf_theta_min_242: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0242Guardrail {

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_242: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_242: 11.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.78 - theta");

        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_244: 20.40,

        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.08 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.08 - abs(cop_x)");

            gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_247: 27.80,
        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_249 | Invariant expr: 0.43 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.43 - ankle_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.43 - ankle_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_249 });
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_249 | Invariant expr: ankle_angle - (-0.56) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("ankle_angle - (-0.56)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("ankle_angle - (-0.56)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_249 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_249 | Invariant expr: 0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_249 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

### CASE STUDY #0253: [PRECISION_MANUFACTURING] FAST_STEERING_MIRROR_PIEZO_LASER_CASE_0252
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for piezoelectric tip-tilt fast steering mirror (FSM) for optical beam pointing and jitter cancellation operating with multi-layer PZT stack actuators with capacitive displacement sensor feedback. Inputs mapped to shared memory are tilt_theta_x_urad, tilt_theta_y_urad, jitter_quadrant_px, jitter_quadrant_py via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Control inputs are piezo_voltage_x (0.0 to 149.24 V), piezo_voltage_y (0.0 to 131.54 V). The safety envelope demands that cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_252 with invariant '149.5 - piezo_voltage_x' (gamma=57.4) and cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_252 with invariant 'piezo_voltage_x - 0.0' (gamma=45.5) and cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_252 with invariant '17.47 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)' (gamma=32.1). Required control frequency is 5000 Hz with a watchdog lease of 1 ms.

<|thought|>
Domain: PRECISION_MANUFACTURING
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 5000 Hz with watchdog lease of 1 ms.
Identified 4 telemetry state variables and 2 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 3 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_PPO, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.
<|thought|>

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0252
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_252: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_252: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_252: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_252: 57.40,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_252: 45.50,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_252: 32.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_252 | Invariant expr: 149.5 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("149.5 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("149.5 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_252 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_252 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_252 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_252 | Invariant expr: 17.47 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("17.47 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("17.47 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_252 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0252
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(200) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=4, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_HAL")
policy = FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0252Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 5000 Hz
```

### CASE STUDY #0254: [ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION] DOUBLE_PENDULUM_CASE_0253
**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a two-link planar acrobot / double inverted pendulum. Observations from the plant include theta1, theta1_dot, theta2, theta2_dot via telemetry. The control policy should stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Commanded output is tau1 (-9.79 to 7.53 Nm), tau2 (-4.81 to 3.99 Nm). Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_253 with invariant '2.49 - theta2' (gamma=13.7) and cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_253 with invariant 'theta2 - (-1.89)' (gamma=13.3). Ensure deterministic execution at 1000 Hz with 2 ms watchdog interlock.

Synthesizing 2 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_LQR_Tree, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};

    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_253: f64,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_253: f64,
}

impl DoublePendulumCase0253Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_253: 13.70,
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_253: 13.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_253 | Invariant expr: 2.49 - theta2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.49 - theta2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.49 - theta2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_253 });
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_253 | Invariant expr: theta2 - (-1.89) (Degree 2)

### CASE STUDY #0255: [ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION] COLLABORATIVE_6DOF_ARM_CASE_0254
**Application Context**: Please generate the Shiva control specification for 6-DOF collaborative robotic manipulator interacting with human operators. The hardware incorporates dual absolute encoder frameless servo joints with integrated torque sensors. Telemetry sensors feed q1, q2, q3, q4 via telemetry. The target mission is to stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. The control action corresponds to tau1 (-63.25 to 69.34 Nm), tau2 (-69.58 to 76.75 Nm), tau3 (-35.34 to 30.43 Nm), tau4 (-21.22 to 22.24 Nm), tau5 (-22.49 to 15.39 Nm), tau6 (-10.05 to 11.91 Nm). Invariants enforced via active-set CBF QP filter: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_254 with invariant '20.43 - tau_ext_norm' (gamma=20.4) and cbf_self_collision_distance_254 with invariant 'dist_mesh - 0.04' (gamma=15.2) and cbf_j2_pos_limit_254 with invariant '2.3 - abs(q2)' (gamma=11.4). Temporal requirements: control frequency 1000 Hz, watchdog timeout 2 ms.

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0254
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0254Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_254: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_254: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_254: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0254Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_254: 20.40,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_254: 15.20,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_254: 11.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_254 | Invariant expr: 20.43 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.43 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.43 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_254 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_254 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_254 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_254 | Invariant expr: 2.3 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.3 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.3 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_254 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0254
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0254FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0254FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

            gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_256: 16.30,
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_256: 10.30,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_256: 8.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_stall_aoa_limit_256 | Invariant expr: 13.98 - aoa_deg (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("13.98 - aoa_deg");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("13.98 - aoa_deg");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_256 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_airspeed_256 | Invariant expr: airspeed_mps - 11.13 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 11.13");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("airspeed_mps - 11.13");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_256 });
        // CBF: cbf_vne_overspeed_256 | Invariant expr: 41.38 - airspeed_mps (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("41.38 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("41.38 - airspeed_mps");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_256 });

    }

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};

use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0259Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_259: f64,
    gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_259: f64,
}

impl ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0259Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_259: 8.60,
            gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_259: 9.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_259 | Invariant expr: 381.26 - reactor_temp_k (Degree 2)

System telemetry streams grid_freq_hz, freq_rocof_hzps, d_axis_current, q_axis_current via telemetry. Our primary objective is stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation is handled via target_active_power_kw (-1344.68 to 1399.0 kW), target_reactive_power_kvar (-889.15 to 810.97 kVAR). Hard safety guarantees must be enforced by the GuardrailNode: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_262 with invariant '57.4 - grid_freq_hz' (gamma=22.4) and cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_262 with invariant 'grid_freq_hz - 52.26' (gamma=21.5) and cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_262 with invariant '94.21 - bess_soc_pct' (gamma=14.4) and cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_262 with invariant 'bess_soc_pct - 11.34' (gamma=13.4) and cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_262 with invariant '2125.92 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)' (gamma=33.6). Run the real-time loop at 200 Hz with a fail-safe watchdog of 5 ms.

// Generated Guardrail Module for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0262
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0262Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_262: f64,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_262: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_262: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_262: f64,
    gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_262: f64,
}

impl BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0262Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_262: 22.40,
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_262: 21.50,
            gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_262: 14.40,
            gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_262: 13.40,
            gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_262: 33.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_262 | Invariant expr: 57.4 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("57.4 - grid_freq_hz");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("57.4 - grid_freq_hz");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_262 });
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_262 | Invariant expr: grid_freq_hz - 52.26 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("grid_freq_hz - 52.26");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("grid_freq_hz - 52.26");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_262 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_262 | Invariant expr: 94.21 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("94.21 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("94.21 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_262 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_262 | Invariant expr: bess_soc_pct - 11.34 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("bess_soc_pct - 11.34");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("bess_soc_pct - 11.34");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_262 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_262 | Invariant expr: 2125.92 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2125.92 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2125.92 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_262 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

// FastDecisionNode implementation for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0262
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0262FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0262FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for double_pendulum_case_0264
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DoublePendulumCase0264Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_264: f64,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_264: f64,
}

impl DoublePendulumCase0264Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_264: 12.80,
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_264: 16.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_264 | Invariant expr: 2.28 - theta2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.28 - theta2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.28 - theta2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_264 });
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_264 | Invariant expr: theta2 - (-2.08) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta2 - (-2.08)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta2 - (-2.08)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_264 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for double_pendulum_case_0264
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class DoublePendulumCase0264FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit DoublePendulumCase0264FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0266
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0266Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_266: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_266: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_266: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0266Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_266: 16.10,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_266: 19.80,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_266: 11.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_266 | Invariant expr: 0.11 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.11 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.11 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_266 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_266 | Invariant expr: 0.05 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_266 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_266 | Invariant expr: 0.62 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.62 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.62 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_266 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;

// Generated Guardrail Module for exoskeleton_knee_assist_case_0271
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0271Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_271: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_271: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_271: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0271Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_271: 26.40,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_271: 24.80,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_271: 19.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_271 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_271 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_271 | Invariant expr: 26.02 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("26.02 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("26.02 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_271 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_271 | Invariant expr: 2.23 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.23 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.23 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_271 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0276
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0276Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_276: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_276: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_276: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0276Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_276: 17.50,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_276: 15.00,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_276: 10.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_276 | Invariant expr: 19.64 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("19.64 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("19.64 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_276 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_276 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_276 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_276 | Invariant expr: 2.36 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.36 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.36 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_276 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0276
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0276FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0276FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

### CASE STUDY #0278: [ROBOTICS_LOCOMOTION] QUADRUPED_LEG_IMPEDANCE_CASE_0277
**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a 3-DOF quadruped robot single leg high-dynamic impedance controller. Observations from the plant include q_hip, q_thigh, q_shank, dq_hip via telemetry. The control policy should stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Commanded output is tau_hip (-17.67 to 15.91 Nm), tau_thigh (-30.88 to 37.68 Nm), tau_knee (-43.29 to 39.15 Nm). Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_277 with invariant 'q_shank - 0.15' (gamma=22.9) and cbf_hip_overtravel_277 with invariant '1.09 - abs(q_hip)' (gamma=15.5) and cbf_ground_penetration_277 with invariant 'foot_pos_z - ground_height' (gamma=22.4). Ensure deterministic execution at 1000 Hz with 2 ms watchdog interlock.

    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_277: f64,

            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_277: 22.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_277: 15.50,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_277: 22.40,

    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.09 - abs(q_hip)");

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0278
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0278Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_278: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_278: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_278: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0278Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_278: 12.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_278: 10.90,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_278: 10.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_278 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_278 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_278 | Invariant expr: 0.85 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.85 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.85 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_278 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_278 | Invariant expr: 19.11 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("19.11 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("19.11 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_278 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0278
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0278FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0278FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0285
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0285Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_285: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_285: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_285: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0285Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_285: 52.20,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_285: 49.70,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_285: 31.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_285 | Invariant expr: 148.32 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("148.32 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("148.32 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_285 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_285 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_285 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_285 | Invariant expr: 22.97 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("22.97 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("22.97 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_285 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_287 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_287 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_287 | Invariant expr: 0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_287 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_287 | Invariant expr: 5.6 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.6 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.6 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_287 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0290
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0290Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_290: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_290: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0290Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_290: 10.60,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_290: 15.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_290 | Invariant expr: 6283.83 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6283.83 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6283.83 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_290 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_290 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_290 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0290
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0290FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0290FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0293Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_293: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_293: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_293: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0293Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_293: 26.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_293: 25.10,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_293: 21.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_293 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");

        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_293 | Invariant expr: 29.45 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("29.45 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("29.45 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_293 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_293 | Invariant expr: 2.34 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.34 - knee_angle");

// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0298
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0298Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_298: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_298: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_298: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0298Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_298: 26.10,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_298: 17.50,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_298: 13.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_298 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_298 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_298 | Invariant expr: 0.8 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.8 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.8 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_298 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_298 | Invariant expr: 4.63 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.63 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.63 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_298 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0300
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0300Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_300: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_300: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0300Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_300: 15.20,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_300: 8.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_300 | Invariant expr: 0.38 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.38 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.38 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_300 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_300 | Invariant expr: 162.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("162.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("162.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_300 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0300
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class HexacopterPayloadDropCase0300FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit HexacopterPayloadDropCase0300FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(4000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

    gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_302: f64,

impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0302Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_302: 8.70,
            gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_302: 15.20,
            gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_302: 14.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_302 | Invariant expr: 0.61 - abs(lateral_error) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.61 - abs(lateral_error)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.61 - abs(lateral_error)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_302 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_302 | Invariant expr: 3.73 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.73 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.73 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_302 });
        // CBF: cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_302 | Invariant expr: 0.57 - abs(steering_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.57 - abs(steering_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.57 - abs(steering_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_302 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

### CASE STUDY #0306: [MARINE_UNDERWATER_VEHICLE] DEEPSEA_AUV_DOCKING_STATION_CASE_0305

// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0305
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0305Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_305: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_305: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_305: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0305Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_305: 13.10,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_305: 13.10,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_305: 15.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_305 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_305 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_305 | Invariant expr: 0.43 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.43 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.43 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_305 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_305 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_305 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0305FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for linear_stage_air_bearing_nanometer_case_0307
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0307Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_307: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_307: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_307: f64,
}

impl LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0307Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_307: 34.30,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_307: 17.60,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_307: 22.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_307 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_307 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_307 | Invariant expr: 178961929.72 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("178961929.72 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("178961929.72 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_307 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_307 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-178961929.72) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-178961929.72)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-178961929.72)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_307 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_force_motor_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_force_motor_y(telemetry);

        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0310
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0310Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_310: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_310: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_310: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0310Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_310: 18.80,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_310: 20.30,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_310: 12.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_310 | Invariant expr: 0.1 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.1 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.1 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_310 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_310 | Invariant expr: 0.07 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.07 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.07 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_310 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_310 | Invariant expr: 0.53 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.53 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.53 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_310 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0312
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0312Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_312: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_312: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0312Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_312: 10.30,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_312: 7.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_312 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_312 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_312 | Invariant expr: 0.19 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.19 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.19 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_312 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0312
