```cpp
class SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0312FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0312FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thruster_fx(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thruster_fy(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thruster_fz(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

### CASE STUDY #0316: [BIOMEDICAL_PROSTHETICS] EXOSKELETON_KNEE_ASSIST_CASE_0315

```rust
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_315: 20.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_315: 20.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.17 - knee_angle");

    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for linear_stage_air_bearing_nanometer_case_0318
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0318Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_318: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_318: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_318: f64,
}

impl LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0318Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_318: 34.10,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_318: 18.10,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_318: 17.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_318 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_318 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_318 | Invariant expr: 223045121.22 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("223045121.22 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("223045121.22 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_318 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_318 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-223045121.22) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-223045121.22)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-223045121.22)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_318 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0320
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0320Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_320: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_320: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_320: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0320Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_320: 22.00,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_320: 15.60,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_320: 14.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_320 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_320 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_320 | Invariant expr: 0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.79 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_320 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_320 | Invariant expr: 5.18 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.18 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.18 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_320 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0320
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0320FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0320FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
class ScaraPickPlaceCase0320Policy(nn.Module):

        self.net = nn.Sequential(

            nn.GELU(),
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0322
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0322Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_322: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_322: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_322: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0322Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_322: 12.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_322: 11.40,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_322: 11.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_322 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_322 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_322 | Invariant expr: 0.94 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.94 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.94 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_322 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_322 | Invariant expr: 31.05 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("31.05 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("31.05 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_322 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0324Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_324: 8.60,

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0327Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_327: f64,

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0327Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_327: 13.40,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_327: 10.80,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_327: 16.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_327 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_327 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_327 | Invariant expr: 0.49 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.49 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.49 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_327 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_327 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0327
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0327FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0327FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0329Guardrail {

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_329: 45.20,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_329: 56.90,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_329: 26.20,
        }

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("18.91 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.75 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.75 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_331 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_331 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_331 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_331 | Invariant expr: 2.28 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.28 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.28 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_331 });
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0339Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_339: f64,
    gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_339: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_339: f64,
}

impl FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0339Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_339: 30.70,
            gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_339: 44.10,
            gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_339: 22.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_339 | Invariant expr: 44152.51 - rotor_speed_rpm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("44152.51 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("44152.51 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_339 });
        // CBF: cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_339 | Invariant expr: 85.63 - rotor_radial_runout_um (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("85.63 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("85.63 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_339 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_extraction_speed_339 | Invariant expr: rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_339 });
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for delicate_gripper_force_case_0342
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DelicateGripperForceCase0342Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_342: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_342: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0342Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_342: 34.10,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_342: 22.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_342 | Invariant expr: 6.14 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6.14 - pinch_force");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6.14 - pinch_force");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_342 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_jaw_stroke_342 | Invariant expr: jaw_gap - 0.001 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_342 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for delicate_gripper_force_case_0342

#include <chrono>

public:
    explicit DelicateGripperForceCase0342FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(500) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 1> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_voice_coil_current(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0347
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0347Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_347: f64,
    gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_347: f64,
}

impl VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0347Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_347: 14.30,
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_347: 14.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_347 | Invariant expr: chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_347 });
        // CBF: cbf_chamber_max_burst_347 | Invariant expr: 49.52 - chamber_pressure_mtorr (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("49.52 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("49.52 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_347 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0347
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0347FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0347FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_mfc_voltage_setpoint(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_gate_valve_angle(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for flywheel_kinetic_ups_frequency_case_0350
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0350Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_350: f64,
    gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_350: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_350: f64,
}

impl FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0350Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_350: 27.00,
            gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_350: 38.40,
            gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_350: 22.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_350 | Invariant expr: 55345.78 - rotor_speed_rpm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("55345.78 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("55345.78 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_350 });
        // CBF: cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_350 | Invariant expr: 104.62 - rotor_radial_runout_um (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("104.62 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("104.62 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_350 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_extraction_speed_350 | Invariant expr: rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_350 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_354: 16.90,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_354: 17.10,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_354: 10.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_354 | Invariant expr: 0.51 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.51 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.51 - abs(pitch_rad)");
```

```rust
impl WorkclassRovManipulatorDepthCase0360Guardrail {

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_hull_collapse_depth_360: 21.80,
            gamma_cbf_max_ascent_umbilical_tension_360: 11.30,
        }
```

```rust
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_364 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_364 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_364 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_364 | Invariant expr: 2.47 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.47 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.47 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_364 });
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0367
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0367Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_367: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_367: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0367Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_367: 9.70,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_367: 12.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_367 | Invariant expr: 5897.33 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5897.33 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5897.33 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_367 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_367 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_367 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0367
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0367FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0367FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_369 | Invariant expr: 237.91 - drum_level_mm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("237.91 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("237.91 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_369 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_369 | Invariant expr: drum_level_mm - (-215.41) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("drum_level_mm - (-215.41)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("drum_level_mm - (-215.41)");
```

```cpp
    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
```

```cpp
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0374
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0374Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_374: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_374: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0374Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_374: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_374: 11.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_374 | Invariant expr: 2.7 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.7 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.7 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_374 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_374 | Invariant expr: theta - (-2.68) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-2.68)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-2.68)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_374 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_378 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_378 | Invariant expr: 0.2 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.2 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.2 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_378 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0386
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0386Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_386: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_386: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_386: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0386Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_386: 22.60,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_386: 19.90,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_386: 14.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_386 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_386 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_386 | Invariant expr: 0.73 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.73 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.73 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_386 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_386 | Invariant expr: 5.52 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.52 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.52 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_386 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0386
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0386FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0386FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0388Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_388: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_388: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0388Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_388: 13.40,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_388: 7.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_388 | Invariant expr: 0.35 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.35 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.35 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_388 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_388 | Invariant expr: 184.46 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("184.46 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("184.46 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_388 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for steam_boiler_drum_level_3element_case_0391
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0391Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_391: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_391: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_391: f64,
}

impl SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0391Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_391: 10.40,
            gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_391: 12.50,
            gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_391: 21.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_391 | Invariant expr: 224.9 - drum_level_mm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("224.9 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("224.9 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_391 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_391 | Invariant expr: drum_level_mm - (-186.82) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("drum_level_mm - (-186.82)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("drum_level_mm - (-186.82)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_391 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_391 | Invariant expr: 165.0 - drum_pressure_bar (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_391 });
```

```rust
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_395 | Invariant expr: 20.33 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.33 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.33 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_395 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0398
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0398Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_398: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_398: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_398: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0398Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_398: 21.00,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_398: 14.60,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_398: 23.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_398 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_398 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_398 | Invariant expr: 1.12 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.12 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.12 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_398 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_398 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_398 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0400
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0400Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_400: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_400: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0400Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_400: 8.80,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_400: 14.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_400 | Invariant expr: 6659.11 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6659.11 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6659.11 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_400 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_400 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_400 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0400
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0400FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0400FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
        self.net = nn.Sequential(

            nn.GELU(),
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for exoskeleton_knee_assist_case_0403
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0403Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_403: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_403: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_403: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0403Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_403: 28.40,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_403: 20.90,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_403: 17.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_403 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_403 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_403 | Invariant expr: 21.77 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("21.77 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("21.77 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_403 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_403 | Invariant expr: 2.2 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.2 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.2 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_403 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

### CASE STUDY #0409: [ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION] SCARA_PICK_PLACE_CASE_0408
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for high-speed 4-DOF SCARA robot for electronics assembly and pick-and-place operating with harmonic drive frameless BLDC motors with EtherCAT CST bus. Inputs mapped to shared memory are q1, q2, z, q4 via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Control inputs are tau1 (-29.63 to 22.66 Nm), tau2 (-13.86 to 17.58 Nm), f_z (-79.66 to 58.51 N), tau4 (-2.19 to 3.33 Nm). The safety envelope demands that cbf_z_table_contact_408 with invariant 'z - 0.005' (gamma=23.4) and cbf_arm_envelope_408 with invariant '0.72 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)' (gamma=20.3) and cbf_q1_slew_408 with invariant '4.53 - abs(q1_dot)' (gamma=13.4). Required control frequency is 1000 Hz with a watchdog lease of 2 ms.

<|thought|>
Domain: ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 1000 Hz with watchdog lease of 2 ms.
Identified 8 telemetry state variables and 4 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 3 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_PPO, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0408
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0408Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_408: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_408: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_408: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0408Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_408: 23.40,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_408: 20.30,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_408: 13.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_408 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_408 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_408 | Invariant expr: 0.72 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.72 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.72 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_408 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_408 | Invariant expr: 4.53 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.53 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.53 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_408 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0408
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0408FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0408FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0408Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=8, act_dim=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_HAL")
policy = ScaraPickPlaceCase0408Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 1000 Hz
```

```rust
impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0409Guardrail {

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_409: 16.00,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_409: 8.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

### CASE STUDY #0411: [AEROSPACE_UAV] HEXACOPTER_PAYLOAD_DROP_CASE_0410
**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a heavy-lift hexacopter delivery platform suspended cable swing attenuation. Observations from the plant include cable_sway_x, cable_sway_y, pos_x, pos_y via telemetry. The control policy should stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Commanded output is acc_cmd_x (-3.22 to 3.67 m/s2), acc_cmd_y (-3.71 to 3.52 m/s2). Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_payload_sway_bound_410 with invariant '0.45 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)' (gamma=15.1) and cbf_geofence_cylinder_410 with invariant '163.16 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)' (gamma=7.4). Ensure deterministic execution at 250 Hz with 8 ms watchdog interlock.

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0410
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0410Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_410: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_410: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0410Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_410: 15.10,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_410: 7.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_410 | Invariant expr: 0.45 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.45 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.45 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_410 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_410 | Invariant expr: 163.16 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("163.16 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("163.16 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_410 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0410

class HexacopterPayloadDropCase0410FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit HexacopterPayloadDropCase0410FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(4000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
pub struct ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0413Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_413: f64,
    gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_413: f64,
}

impl ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0413Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_413: 9.00,
            gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_413: 11.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
```

```rust
pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0415Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_415: f64,

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_415: 13.60,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_415: 13.30,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_415: 17.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.49 - surge_vx");

        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_415 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_415 });
```

```cpp
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cart_pole_case_0418
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CartPoleCase0418Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_418: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_418: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_418: f64,
}

impl CartPoleCase0418Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_418: 8.70,
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_418: 9.50,
            gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_418: 9.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_pos_418 | Invariant expr: 1.09 - x (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.09 - x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.09 - x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_418 });
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_neg_418 | Invariant expr: x - (-1.06) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("x - (-1.06)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("x - (-1.06)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_418 });
        // CBF: cbf_pole_fall_safety_418 | Invariant expr: {max_theta} - abs(theta) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_418 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0420
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0420Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_420: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_420: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_420: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0420Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_420: 20.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_420: 16.70,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_420: 23.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_420 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_420 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_420 | Invariant expr: 0.85 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_420 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_420 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_420 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0420
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0420FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0420FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_knee(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DelicateGripperForceCase0430Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_430: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_430: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0430Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_430: 32.70,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_430: 22.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_430 | Invariant expr: 5.41 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.41 - pinch_force");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.41 - pinch_force");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_430 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_jaw_stroke_430 | Invariant expr: jaw_gap - 0.001 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_430 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0433
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0433Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_433: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_433: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0433Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_433: 10.10,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_433: 15.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_433 | Invariant expr: 7115.13 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("7115.13 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("7115.13 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_433 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_433 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_433 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0433

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0433FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0433FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
pub struct FixedWingUavGlideCase0443Guardrail {

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_443: 18.00,
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_443: 12.70,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_443: 8.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 12.53");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("airspeed_mps - 12.53");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_443 });
        // CBF: cbf_vne_overspeed_443 | Invariant expr: 39.42 - airspeed_mps (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("39.42 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("39.42 - airspeed_mps");
```

```rust
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_450: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0450Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_450: 46.30,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_450: 56.20,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_450: 32.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_450 | Invariant expr: 133.88 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("133.88 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("133.88 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_450 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_450 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_450 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_450 | Invariant expr: 19.36 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("19.36 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("19.36 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_450 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0453Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_453: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_453: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0453Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_453: 15.10,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_453: 9.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_453 | Invariant expr: 0.54 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.54 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.54 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_453 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_453 | Invariant expr: 4.19 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.19 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.19 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_453 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
```

```rust
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_455 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_455 });
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0456Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_456: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_456: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_456: f64,
}

impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0456Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_456: 9.80,
            gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_456: 13.50,
            gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_456: 17.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_456 | Invariant expr: 0.88 - abs(lateral_error) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.88 - abs(lateral_error)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.88 - abs(lateral_error)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_456 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_456 | Invariant expr: 3.71 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.71 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.71 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_456 });
        // CBF: cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_456 | Invariant expr: 0.6 - abs(steering_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.6 - abs(steering_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.6 - abs(steering_angle)");

        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0461
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0461Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_461: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_461: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_461: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0461Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_461: 56.40,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_461: 47.40,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_461: 29.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_461 | Invariant expr: 149.87 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("149.87 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("149.87 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_461 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_461 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_461 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_461 | Invariant expr: 15.29 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("15.29 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("15.29 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_461 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0464Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_464: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_464: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0464Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_464: 17.70,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_464: 7.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_464 | Invariant expr: 0.37 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.37 - abs(pitch_angle)");
```

```rust
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_466: 10.80,

        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```
