use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0469Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_469: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_469: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_469: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0469Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_469: 29.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_469: 21.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_469: 17.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_469 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_469 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_469 | Invariant expr: 23.27 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.27 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.27 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_469 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_469 | Invariant expr: 2.39 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.39 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.39 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_469 });

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0474Guardrail {

}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0474Guardrail {

        Self {

            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_474: 19.70,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_474: 12.90,
        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.75 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_474 });

        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;

use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0476Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_476: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0476Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_476: 13.20,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_476: 8.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_476 | Invariant expr: 0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");

        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_476 | Invariant expr: 94.95 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("94.95 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("94.95 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");

// Generated Guardrail Module for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0479
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0479Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_479: f64,
    gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_479: f64,
}

impl VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0479Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_479: 15.70,
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_479: 13.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_479 | Invariant expr: chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_479 });
        // CBF: cbf_chamber_max_burst_479 | Invariant expr: 62.83 - chamber_pressure_mtorr (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("62.83 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("62.83 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_479 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0484
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0484Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_484: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_484: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0484Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_484: 12.10,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_484: 13.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_484 | Invariant expr: 2.05 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.05 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.05 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_484 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_484 | Invariant expr: theta - (-1.89) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-1.89)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-1.89)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_484 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0485Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_485: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_485: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_485: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0485Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_485: 20.90,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_485: 14.70,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_485: 10.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_485 | Invariant expr: 17.69 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("17.69 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("17.69 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_485 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_485 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_485 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_485 | Invariant expr: 2.5 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.5 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.5 - abs(q2)");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_493 });

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),

    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_496: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_496: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0496Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_496: 33.50,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_496: 22.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_496 | Invariant expr: 2.89 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.89 - pinch_force");

        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0499
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0499Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_499: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_499: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0499Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_499: 12.80,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_499: 8.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_499 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_499 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_499 | Invariant expr: 0.25 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_499 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0504
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0504Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_504: f64,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_504: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_504: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_504: f64,
    gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_504: f64,
}

impl BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0504Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_504: 22.60,
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_504: 24.40,
            gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_504: 16.80,
            gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_504: 15.80,
            gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_504: 36.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_504 | Invariant expr: 51.35 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("51.35 - grid_freq_hz");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("51.35 - grid_freq_hz");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_504 });
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_504 | Invariant expr: grid_freq_hz - 49.93 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("grid_freq_hz - 49.93");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("grid_freq_hz - 49.93");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_504 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_504 | Invariant expr: 92.6 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("92.6 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("92.6 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_504 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_504 | Invariant expr: bess_soc_pct - 10.57 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("bess_soc_pct - 10.57");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("bess_soc_pct - 10.57");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_504 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_504 | Invariant expr: 1534.84 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1534.84 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1534.84 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_504 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0504
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0504FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0504FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0504Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=6, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0509
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0509Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_509: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_509: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_509: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0509Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_509: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_509: 11.50,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_509: 8.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_509 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_509 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_509 | Invariant expr: 0.93 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.93 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.93 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_509 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_509 | Invariant expr: 45.47 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("45.47 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("45.47 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_509 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0509
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0509FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0509FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0509Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=8, act_dim=4):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_511 });

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.63 - abs(steering_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.63 - abs(steering_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_511 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0514
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_514: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_514: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_514: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_514: 15.90,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_514: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_514: 15.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_514 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_514 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_514 | Invariant expr: 0.53 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.53 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.53 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_514 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_514 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_514 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0514
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=6, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization

policy = DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0514Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 100 Hz

use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0516Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_516: f64,

    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_516: 41.50,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_516: 22.60,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_516: 17.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_516 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");

        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_516 | Invariant expr: 193626238.44 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("193626238.44 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("193626238.44 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_516 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_516 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-193626238.44) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-193626238.44)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-193626238.44)");

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_force_motor_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_force_motor_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a direct-drive brushless rotary inverted pendulum. Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_theta_max_517 with invariant '1.94 - theta' (gamma=13.3) and cbf_theta_min_517 with invariant 'theta - (-2.0)' (gamma=12.2). ```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0519
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0519Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_519: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_519: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0519Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_519: 15.80,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_519: 8.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_519 | Invariant expr: 0.48 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.48 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.48 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_519 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_519 | Invariant expr: 4.05 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.05 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.05 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_519 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0521
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0521Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_521: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_521: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0521Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_521: 10.70,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_521: 7.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_521 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_521 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_521 | Invariant expr: 0.19 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.19 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.19 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_521 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0521

class SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0521FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0521FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thruster_fx(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thruster_fy(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thruster_fz(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for powered_transtibial_prosthesis_case_0524
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0524Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_524: f64,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_524: f64,
    gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_524: f64,
}

impl PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0524Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_524: 22.10,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_524: 18.70,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_524: 17.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_524 | Invariant expr: 0.36 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.36 - ankle_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.36 - ankle_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_524 });
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_524 | Invariant expr: ankle_angle - (-0.49) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("ankle_angle - (-0.49)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("ankle_angle - (-0.49)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_524 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_524 | Invariant expr: 0.14 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.14 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.14 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_524 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0530Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_530: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_530: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0530Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_530: 14.50,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_530: 8.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_530 | Invariant expr: 0.48 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.48 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.48 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_530 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_530 | Invariant expr: 3.67 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.67 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.67 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_530 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0536
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0536Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_536: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_536: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_536: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0536Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_536: 14.60,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_536: 10.40,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_536: 14.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_536 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_536 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_536 | Invariant expr: 0.41 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.41 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.41 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_536 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_536 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_536 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0541
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0541Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_541: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_541: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_541: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0541Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_541: 22.00,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_541: 13.40,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_541: 28.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_541 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_541 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_541 | Invariant expr: 0.89 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.89 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.89 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_541 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_541 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_541 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0543
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0543Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_543: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_543: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0543Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_543: 12.00,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_543: 7.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_543 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_543 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_543 | Invariant expr: 0.25 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_543 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0543
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0543FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0543FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thruster_fx(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thruster_fy(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thruster_fz(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

Run the real-time loop at 200 Hz with a fail-safe watchdog of 5 ms.

// Generated Guardrail Module for powered_transtibial_prosthesis_case_0546
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0546Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_546: f64,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_546: f64,
    gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_546: f64,
}

impl PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0546Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_546: 24.50,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_546: 23.60,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_546: 16.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_546 | Invariant expr: 0.46 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.46 - ankle_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.46 - ankle_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_546 });
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_546 | Invariant expr: ankle_angle - (-0.54) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("ankle_angle - (-0.54)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("ankle_angle - (-0.54)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_546 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_546 | Invariant expr: 0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_546 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0551
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0551Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_551: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_551: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_551: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0551Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_551: 25.30,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_551: 18.90,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_551: 13.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_551 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_551 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_551 | Invariant expr: 0.75 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.75 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.75 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_551 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_551 | Invariant expr: 5.03 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.03 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.03 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_551 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0551
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0551FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0551FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0553Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_553: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_553: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_553: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0553Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_553: 13.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_553: 11.70,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_553: 11.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_553 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_553 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_553 | Invariant expr: 0.87 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.87 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.87 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_553 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_553 | Invariant expr: 46.08 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("46.08 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("46.08 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_553 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0558Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_558: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_558: f64,

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0558Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_558: 13.70,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_558: 10.70,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_558: 15.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_558 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_558 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_558 | Invariant expr: 0.56 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.56 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.56 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_558 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_558 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_558 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0563Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_563: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_563: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_563: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0563Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_563: 19.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_563: 14.10,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_563: 22.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_563 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_563 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_563 | Invariant expr: 0.88 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_563 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_563 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_563 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }

    gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_566: f64,
}

impl RegenerativeBrakeByWireAntiLockCase0566Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_peak_friction_slip_limit_566: 27.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_566: 29.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

### CASE STUDY #0572: [PRECISION_MANUFACTURING] FAST_STEERING_MIRROR_PIEZO_LASER_CASE_0571

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0571
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0571Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_571: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_571: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_571: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0571Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_571: 50.90,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_571: 44.60,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_571: 26.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_571 | Invariant expr: 137.04 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("137.04 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("137.04 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_571 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_571 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_571 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_571 | Invariant expr: 21.18 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("21.18 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("21.18 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_571 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

// FastDecisionNode implementation for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0571
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0571FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0571FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(200) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0574
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0574Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_574: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_574: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_574: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0574Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_574: 20.60,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_574: 15.50,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_574: 21.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_574 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_574 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_574 | Invariant expr: 1.18 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.18 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.18 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_574 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_574 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_574 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0576
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0576Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_576: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_576: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0576Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_576: 11.30,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_576: 12.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_576 | Invariant expr: 6186.25 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6186.25 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6186.25 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_576 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_576 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_576 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0576
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0576FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0576FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

        }

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("225.96 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("225.96 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_578 });

            gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_583: 7.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0585
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0585Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_585: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_585: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0585Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_585: 15.60,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_585: 7.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_585 | Invariant expr: 0.49 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.49 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.49 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_585 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_585 | Invariant expr: 3.21 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.21 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.21 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_585 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0585
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0585FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0585FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_left(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_right(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)

            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_590: 17.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_590 });

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("19.93 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("19.93 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_590 });

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.18 - knee_angle");

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0595
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0595Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_595: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_595: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_595: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0595Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_595: 19.60,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_595: 13.90,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_595: 13.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_595 | Invariant expr: 23.45 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.45 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.45 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_595 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_595 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_595 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_595 | Invariant expr: 2.28 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.28 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.28 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_595 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0595
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0595FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0595FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0597
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0597Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_597: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_597: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0597Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_597: 16.00,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_597: 7.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_597 | Invariant expr: 0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.27 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_597 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_597 | Invariant expr: 141.96 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("141.96 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("141.96 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_597 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

// FastDecisionNode implementation for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0597

class HexacopterPayloadDropCase0597FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit HexacopterPayloadDropCase0597FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(4000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};

// Generated Guardrail Module for chemical_cstr_temperature_ph_case_0600
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0600Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_600: f64,
    gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_600: f64,
}

impl ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0600Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_600: 8.70,
            gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_600: 10.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_600 | Invariant expr: 391.93 - reactor_temp_k (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("391.93 - reactor_temp_k");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("391.93 - reactor_temp_k");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_600 });
        // CBF: cbf_reactor_underpressure_600 | Invariant expr: reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_600 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(500) {}

    void step() noexcept override {

// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0605
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0605Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_605: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_605: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0605Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_605: 12.90,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_605: 12.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_605 | Invariant expr: 1.82 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.82 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.82 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_605 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_605 | Invariant expr: theta - (-2.07) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-2.07)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-2.07)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_605 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
