#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for drive_by_wire_steering_lane_centering_case_0610
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0610Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_610: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_610: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_610: f64,
}

impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0610Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_610: 10.00,
            gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_610: 15.00,
            gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_610: 16.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_610 | Invariant expr: 0.73 - abs(lateral_error) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.73 - abs(lateral_error)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.73 - abs(lateral_error)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_610 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_610 | Invariant expr: 3.26 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.26 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.26 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_610 });
        // CBF: cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_610 | Invariant expr: 0.67 - abs(steering_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.67 - abs(steering_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.67 - abs(steering_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_610 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0615
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_615: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_615: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_615: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_615: 57.30,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_615: 43.90,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_615: 32.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_615 | Invariant expr: 133.36 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("133.36 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("133.36 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_615 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_615 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_615 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_615 | Invariant expr: 22.83 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("22.83 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("22.83 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_615 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0615
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(200) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=4, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_HAL")
policy = FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0615Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 5000 Hz
```

```rust
pub struct BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0625Guardrail {

impl BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0625Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),

        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("53.11 - grid_freq_hz");

        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_625 | Invariant expr: 94.07 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("94.07 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("94.07 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_625 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_625 | Invariant expr: bess_soc_pct - 11.79 (Degree 1)
```

```cpp
    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action

        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DoublePendulumCase0627Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_627: f64,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_627: f64,
}

impl DoublePendulumCase0627Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_627: 17.00,
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_627: 14.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_627 | Invariant expr: 2.42 - theta2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.42 - theta2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.42 - theta2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_627 });
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_627 | Invariant expr: theta2 - (-2.26) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta2 - (-2.26)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta2 - (-2.26)");

    }

    }
```
```cpp
private:

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0630
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0630Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_630: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_630: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0630Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_630: 14.30,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_630: 8.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_630 | Invariant expr: 0.37 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.37 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.37 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_630 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_630 | Invariant expr: 144.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("144.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("144.09 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_630 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0630

public:
    explicit HexacopterPayloadDropCase0630FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(4000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_acc_cmd_y(telemetry);

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0635
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0635Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_635: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_635: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_635: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0635Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_635: 13.80,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_635: 10.40,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_635: 16.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_635 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_635 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_635 | Invariant expr: 0.56 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.56 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.56 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_635 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_635 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_635 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_637 | Invariant expr: 143.78 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("143.78 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("143.78 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_637 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_637 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
```

```rust
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_639: 20.20,

        }
    }

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_639 });

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.34 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.34 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_639 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0642
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0642Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_642: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_642: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0642Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_642: 9.50,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_642: 13.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_642 | Invariant expr: 6698.5 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6698.5 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6698.5 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_642 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_642 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_642 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0642FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_neg_649 | Invariant expr: x - (-1.0) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("x - (-1.0)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("x - (-1.0)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_649 });
        // CBF: cbf_pole_fall_safety_649 | Invariant expr: {max_theta} - abs(theta) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_649 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

### CASE STUDY #0656: [INDUSTRIAL_PROCESS_CONTROL] VACUUM_SPUTTERING_GAS_MASS_FLOW_CASE_0655
**Application Context**: We are building a control system in Shiva for semiconductor physical vapor deposition (PVD) vacuum chamber plasma pressure and argon gas flow. The plant uses piezoelectric fast mass flow controller (MFC) valve + turbomolecular throttle gate. We have telemetry measuring chamber_pressure_mtorr, argon_flow_sccm, plasma_bias_v via telemetry. We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands mfc_voltage_setpoint (0.0 to 5.0 V), gate_valve_angle (0.0 to 90.0 deg). Critically, safety constraints require that cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_655 with invariant 'chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2' (gamma=17.2) and cbf_chamber_max_burst_655 with invariant '49.44 - chamber_pressure_mtorr' (gamma=13.9). The loop must execute deterministically at 200 Hz with a 8 ms watchdog lease.

<|thought|>
Domain: INDUSTRIAL_PROCESS_CONTROL
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 200 Hz with watchdog lease of 8 ms.
Identified 3 telemetry state variables and 2 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 2 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_TD3, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0655
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_655: f64,
    gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_655: f64,
}

impl VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_655: 17.20,
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_655: 13.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_655 | Invariant expr: chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_655 });
        // CBF: cbf_chamber_max_burst_655 | Invariant expr: 49.44 - chamber_pressure_mtorr (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("49.44 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("49.44 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_655 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0655
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_mfc_voltage_setpoint(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_gate_valve_angle(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=3, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_EtherCAT_CST")
policy = VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0655Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 200 Hz
```

### CASE STUDY #0658: [MARINE_UNDERWATER_VEHICLE] DEEPSEA_AUV_DOCKING_STATION_CASE_0657
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) 6-DOF seafloor funnel cone docking latch operating with magnetic coupling brushless thrusters with contra-rotating ducted props. Inputs mapped to shared memory are surge_x, sway_y, heave_z, surge_vx via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Control inputs are thrust_forward (0.0 to 109.59 N), thrust_vertical (-37.77 to 37.73 N), thrust_lateral (-18.34 to 17.92 N). The safety envelope demands that cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_657 with invariant 'surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)' (gamma=14.5) and cbf_dock_impact_velocity_657 with invariant '0.54 - surge_vx' (gamma=11.8) and cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_657 with invariant 'altitude_above_bottom - 1.2' (gamma=13.6). Required control frequency is 100 Hz with a watchdog lease of 25 ms.

```json
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0660
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0660Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_660: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_660: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0660Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_660: 12.30,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_660: 10.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_660 | Invariant expr: 2.41 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.41 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.41 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_660 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_660 | Invariant expr: theta - (-2.5) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-2.5)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-2.5)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_660 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
public:
    explicit InvertedPendulumCase0660FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0662
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0662Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_662: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_662: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_662: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0662Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_662: 15.80,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_662: 18.80,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_662: 11.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_662 | Invariant expr: 0.09 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_662 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_662 | Invariant expr: 0.06 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_662 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_662 | Invariant expr: 0.58 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.58 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.58 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_662 });

    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for linear_stage_air_bearing_nanometer_case_0670
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0670Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_670: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_670: f64,
    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_670: f64,
}

impl LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0670Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_670: 37.30,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_670: 22.60,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_670: 18.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_670 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_670 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_670 | Invariant expr: 213642545.78 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("213642545.78 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("213642545.78 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_670 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_670 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-213642545.78) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-213642545.78)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-213642545.78)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_670 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for linear_stage_air_bearing_nanometer_case_0670
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0670FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0670FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(500) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_force_motor_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_force_motor_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0672
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0672Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_672: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_672: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_672: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0672Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_672: 17.30,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_672: 16.60,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_672: 10.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_672 | Invariant expr: 22.3 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("22.3 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("22.3 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_672 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_672 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_672 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_672 | Invariant expr: 2.46 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.46 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.46 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_672 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```cpp
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for flywheel_kinetic_ups_frequency_case_0680
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0680Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_680: f64,
    gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_680: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_680: f64,
}

impl FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0680Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_680: 29.60,
            gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_680: 35.20,
            gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_680: 27.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_680 | Invariant expr: 57695.48 - rotor_speed_rpm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("57695.48 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("57695.48 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_680 });
        // CBF: cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_680 | Invariant expr: 98.6 - rotor_radial_runout_um (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("98.6 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("98.6 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_680 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_extraction_speed_680 | Invariant expr: rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_680 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0684Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,

    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_684: f64,
}

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_684: 17.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_684: 14.00,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_684: 23.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_684 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_684 });

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_684 });

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
```

```rust
    }

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0685Guardrail {

        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0690
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0690Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_690: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_690: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_690: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0690Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_690: 15.30,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_690: 12.80,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_690: 17.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_690 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_690 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_690 | Invariant expr: 0.58 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.58 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.58 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_690 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_690 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_690 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0695
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0695Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_695: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_695: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0695Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_695: 17.90,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_695: 7.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_695 | Invariant expr: 0.43 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.43 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.43 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_695 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_695 | Invariant expr: 4.73 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.73 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.73 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_695 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_697: f64,

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0697Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_697: 11.80,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_697: 8.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_697 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");

    }
```

```cpp
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for exoskeleton_knee_assist_case_0700
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0700Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_700: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_700: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_700: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0700Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_700: 30.30,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_700: 27.50,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_700: 22.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_700 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_700 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_700 | Invariant expr: 20.72 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.72 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.72 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_700 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_700 | Invariant expr: 2.39 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.39 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.39 - knee_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_700 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for scara_pick_place_case_0705
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ScaraPickPlaceCase0705Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_705: f64,
    gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_705: f64,
    gamma_cbf_q1_slew_705: f64,
}

impl ScaraPickPlaceCase0705Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_705: 26.60,
            gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_705: 19.80,
            gamma_cbf_q1_slew_705: 12.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_z_table_contact_705 | Invariant expr: z - 0.005 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.005");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_705 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_705 | Invariant expr: 0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_705 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_705 | Invariant expr: 5.86 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.86 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.86 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_705 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for scara_pick_place_case_0705
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class ScaraPickPlaceCase0705FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit ScaraPickPlaceCase0705FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_f_z(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fixed_wing_uav_glide_case_0707
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FixedWingUavGlideCase0707Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_707: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_707: f64,
    gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_707: f64,
}

impl FixedWingUavGlideCase0707Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_707: 20.20,
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_707: 12.20,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_707: 10.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_stall_aoa_limit_707 | Invariant expr: 14.84 - aoa_deg (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("14.84 - aoa_deg");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("14.84 - aoa_deg");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stall_aoa_limit_707 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_airspeed_707 | Invariant expr: airspeed_mps - 11.92 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 11.92");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("airspeed_mps - 11.92");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_707 });
        // CBF: cbf_vne_overspeed_707 | Invariant expr: 37.87 - airspeed_mps (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("37.87 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("37.87 - airspeed_mps");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_707 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
```

```rust
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_709 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_709 | Invariant expr: 4.38 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.38 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_709 });
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for deepsea_auv_docking_station_case_0712
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0712Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_712: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_712: f64,
    gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_712: f64,
}

impl DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0712Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_712: 14.20,
            gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_712: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_712: 16.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_712 | Invariant expr: surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_712 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_impact_velocity_712 | Invariant expr: 0.42 - surge_vx (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.42 - surge_vx");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.42 - surge_vx");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_impact_velocity_712 });
        // CBF: cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_712 | Invariant expr: altitude_above_bottom - 1.2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("altitude_above_bottom - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_712 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
class DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0712FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {

    explicit DeepseaAuvDockingStationCase0712FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_forward(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thrust_vertical(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thrust_lateral(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0717
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0717Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_717: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_717: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0717Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_717: 17.20,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_717: 7.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_717 | Invariant expr: 0.4 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.4 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.4 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_717 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_717 | Invariant expr: 3.48 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.48 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.48 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_717 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0717FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {

    explicit WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0717FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_left(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_right(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0719
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0719Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_719: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_719: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0719Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_719: 9.70,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_719: 13.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_719 | Invariant expr: 6113.8 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6113.8 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6113.8 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_719 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_719 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_719 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0719
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0719FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0719FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0719Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=10, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)
```

### CASE STUDY #0723: [BIOMEDICAL_PROSTHETICS] POWERED_TRANSTIBIAL_PROSTHESIS_CASE_0722
**Application Context**: Configure Shiva.ai middleware for a active powered bionic ankle-foot prosthesis for below-knee amputee walking push-off. System telemetry streams ankle_angle, ankle_velocity, sea_spring_deflection, socket_emg_envelope via telemetry. Our primary objective is stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation is handled via motor_torque_cmd (-54.71 to 68.61 Nm). Hard safety guarantees must be enforced by the GuardrailNode: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_722 with invariant '0.36 - ankle_angle' (gamma=19.0) and cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_722 with invariant 'ankle_angle - (-0.65)' (gamma=24.3) and cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_722 with invariant '0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)' (gamma=17.0). Run the real-time loop at 1000 Hz with a fail-safe watchdog of 2 ms.

<|thought|>
Domain: BIOMEDICAL_PROSTHETICS
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 1000 Hz with watchdog lease of 2 ms.
Identified 5 telemetry state variables and 1 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 3 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_TD3, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.
<|thought|>

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for powered_transtibial_prosthesis_case_0722
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_722: f64,
    gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_722: f64,
    gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_722: f64,
}

impl PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_722: 19.00,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_722: 24.30,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_722: 17.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_722 | Invariant expr: 0.36 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.36 - ankle_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.36 - ankle_angle");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_722 });
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_722 | Invariant expr: ankle_angle - (-0.65) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("ankle_angle - (-0.65)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("ankle_angle - (-0.65)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_722 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_722 | Invariant expr: 0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_722 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for powered_transtibial_prosthesis_case_0722
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 1> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_motor_torque_cmd(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=5, act_dim=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_EtherCAT_CST")
policy = PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0722Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 1000 Hz
```

### CASE STUDY #0724: [MARINE_UNDERWATER_VEHICLE] DEEPSEA_AUV_DOCKING_STATION_CASE_0723
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) 6-DOF seafloor funnel cone docking latch operating with magnetic coupling brushless thrusters with contra-rotating ducted props. Control inputs are thrust_forward (0.0 to 112.84 N), thrust_vertical (-31.07 to 26.77 N), thrust_lateral (-27.37 to 19.55 N). The safety envelope demands that cbf_docking_cone_funnel_boundary_723 with invariant 'surge_x * tan(0.35) - sqrt(sway_y^2 + heave_z^2)' (gamma=12.6) and cbf_dock_impact_velocity_723 with invariant '0.54 - surge_vx' (gamma=13.4) and cbf_seafloor_hull_clearance_723 with invariant 'altitude_above_bottom - 1.2' (gamma=14.4). Required control frequency is 100 Hz with a watchdog lease of 25 ms.

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for delicate_gripper_force_case_0727
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DelicateGripperForceCase0727Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_727: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_727: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0727Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_727: 28.40,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_727: 18.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_727 | Invariant expr: 2.14 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.14 - pinch_force");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.14 - pinch_force");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_727 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_jaw_stroke_727 | Invariant expr: jaw_gap - 0.001 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_727 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0730
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0730Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_730: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_730: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0730Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_730: 10.70,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_730: 13.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_730 | Invariant expr: 6946.21 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6946.21 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6946.21 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_730 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_730 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_730 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for chemical_cstr_temperature_ph_case_0732
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0732Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_732: f64,
    gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_732: f64,
}

impl ChemicalCstrTemperaturePhCase0732Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_732: 8.00,
            gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_732: 10.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_732 | Invariant expr: 399.79 - reactor_temp_k (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("399.79 - reactor_temp_k");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("399.79 - reactor_temp_k");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_732 });
        // CBF: cbf_reactor_underpressure_732 | Invariant expr: reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_732 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(10000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action

        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_coolant_valve_flow(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_feed_flow_rate(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cart_pole_case_0737
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CartPoleCase0737Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_737: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_737: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_737: f64,
}

impl CartPoleCase0737Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_737: 9.00,
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_737: 10.30,
            gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_737: 7.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_pos_737 | Invariant expr: 1.07 - x (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.07 - x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.07 - x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_737 });
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_neg_737 | Invariant expr: x - (-1.19) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("x - (-1.19)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("x - (-1.19)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_737 });
        // CBF: cbf_pole_fall_safety_737 | Invariant expr: {max_theta} - abs(theta) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_737 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0739
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0739Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_739: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_739: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_739: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0739Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_739: 19.10,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_739: 18.60,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_739: 13.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_739 | Invariant expr: 0.11 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.11 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.11 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_739 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_739 | Invariant expr: 0.06 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.06 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_739 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_739 | Invariant expr: 0.68 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.68 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.68 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_739 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0739
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0739FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0739FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_746 | Invariant expr: 56.92 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("56.92 - grid_freq_hz");

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("92.62 - bess_soc_pct");
```
