#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0749
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0749Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_749: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_749: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_749: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0749Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_749: 18.20,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_749: 17.00,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_749: 11.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_749 | Invariant expr: 23.3 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.3 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.3 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_749 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_749 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_749 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_749 | Invariant expr: 2.44 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.44 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.44 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_749 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0749
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0749FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0749FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0751
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0751Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_751: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_751: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_751: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0751Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_751: 15.70,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_751: 10.60,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_751: 10.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_751 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_751 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_751 | Invariant expr: 0.97 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.97 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.97 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_751 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_751 | Invariant expr: 49.41 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("49.41 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("49.41 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_751 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);

    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0758Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_758: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_758: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_758: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0758Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_758: 53.80,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_758: 44.10,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_758: 31.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_758 | Invariant expr: 137.02 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("137.02 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("137.02 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_758 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_758 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_758 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_758 | Invariant expr: 19.08 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("19.08 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("19.08 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");

        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
```

```rust
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.005");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_z_table_contact_760 });
        // CBF: cbf_arm_envelope_760 | Invariant expr: 0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.78 - sqrt((0.4*cos(q1)+0.3*cos(q1+q2))^2 + (0.4*sin(q1)+0.3*sin(q1+q2))^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_arm_envelope_760 });
        // CBF: cbf_q1_slew_760 | Invariant expr: 5.65 - abs(q1_dot) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.65 - abs(q1_dot)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.65 - abs(q1_dot)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_q1_slew_760 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0761
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0761Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_761: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_761: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_761: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0761Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_761: 17.60,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_761: 15.80,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_761: 25.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_761 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_761 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_761 | Invariant expr: 1.05 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.05 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.05 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_761 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_761 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_761 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

### CASE STUDY #0764: [AEROSPACE_SPACECRAFT] CUBESAT_REACTION_WHEEL_CASE_0763
**Application Context**: We are building a control system in Shiva for 3U CubeSat fine pointing attitude determination and control system (ADCS). The plant uses 3-axis orthogonal miniature reaction wheel assembly + magnetic torque rods. We have telemetry measuring q_error_w, q_error_x, q_error_y, q_error_z via telemetry. We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands tau_rw_x (-11.93 to 19.05 mNm), tau_rw_y (-12.28 to 10.44 mNm), tau_rw_z (-18.17 to 13.4 mNm). Critically, safety constraints require that cbf_rw_speed_saturation_763 with invariant '6866.07 - abs(rw_speed_x)' (gamma=11.0) and cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_763 with invariant 'sun_payload_angle - 0.785' (gamma=12.9). The loop must execute deterministically at 50 Hz with a 40 ms watchdog lease.

<|thought|>
Domain: AEROSPACE_SPACECRAFT
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 50 Hz with watchdog lease of 40 ms.
Identified 10 telemetry state variables and 3 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 2 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_CPO, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.
<|thought|>

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0763
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0763Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_763: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_763: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0763Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_763: 11.00,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_763: 12.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_763 | Invariant expr: 6866.07 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6866.07 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6866.07 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_763 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_763 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_763 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0763
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0763FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0763FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0763Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=10, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_CANopen")
policy = CubesatReactionWheelCase0763Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 50 Hz
```

### CASE STUDY #0765: [AUTOMOTIVE_AUTONOMOUS_VEHICLE] DRIVE_BY_WIRE_STEERING_LANE_CENTERING_CASE_0764
**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a electric power steering (EPS) steer-by-wire high-speed highway lane keep assist. Observations from the plant include lateral_error, heading_error, yaw_rate, road_curvature via telemetry. The control policy should stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Commanded output is tau_steering_motor (-11.88 to 9.48 Nm). Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_764 with invariant '0.84 - abs(lateral_error)' (gamma=11.2) and cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_764 with invariant '3.64 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)' (gamma=13.4) and cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_764 with invariant '0.66 - abs(steering_angle)' (gamma=16.2). Ensure deterministic execution at 200 Hz with 5 ms watchdog interlock.

Domain: AUTOMOTIVE_AUTONOMOUS_VEHICLE
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 200 Hz with watchdog lease of 5 ms.
Identified 6 telemetry state variables and 1 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 3 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_CPO, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for drive_by_wire_steering_lane_centering_case_0764
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0764Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_764: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_764: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_764: f64,
}

impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0764Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_764: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_764: 13.40,
            gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_764: 16.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_764 | Invariant expr: 0.84 - abs(lateral_error) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.84 - abs(lateral_error)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.84 - abs(lateral_error)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_764 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_764 | Invariant expr: 3.64 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("3.64 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("3.64 - abs(vehicle_speed * yaw_rate)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_764 });
        // CBF: cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_764 | Invariant expr: 0.66 - abs(steering_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.66 - abs(steering_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.66 - abs(steering_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_764 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

### CASE STUDY #0766: [INDUSTRIAL_PROCESS_CONTROL] CHEMICAL_CSTR_TEMPERATURE_PH_CASE_0765
**Application Context**: We are building a control system in Shiva for continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR) exothermic jacket temperature and concentration control. The plant uses pneumatic diaphragm control valve and variable speed coolant chiller pump. We have telemetry measuring reactor_temp_k, jacket_temp_k, reactant_concentration, temp_rate_kps via telemetry. We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands coolant_valve_flow (0.0 to 0.14 m3/s), feed_flow_rate (0.0 to 0.03 m3/s). Critically, safety constraints require that cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_765 with invariant '407.17 - reactor_temp_k' (gamma=9.0) and cbf_reactor_underpressure_765 with invariant 'reactor_pressure_bar - 1.1' (gamma=11.1). The loop must execute deterministically at 100 Hz with a 20 ms watchdog lease.

```rust
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_thermal_runaway_trip_765: 9.00,
            gamma_cbf_reactor_underpressure_765: 11.10,
        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("95.36 - bess_soc_pct");
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for double_pendulum_case_0770
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DoublePendulumCase0770Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_770: f64,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_770: f64,
}

impl DoublePendulumCase0770Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_770: 14.10,
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_770: 17.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_770 | Invariant expr: 2.06 - theta2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.06 - theta2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.06 - theta2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_770 });
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_770 | Invariant expr: theta2 - (-2.17) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta2 - (-2.17)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta2 - (-2.17)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_770 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for double_pendulum_case_0770
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class DoublePendulumCase0770FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit DoublePendulumCase0770FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0772
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0772Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_772: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_772: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_772: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0772Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_772: 22.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_772: 12.80,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_772: 22.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_772 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_772 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_772 | Invariant expr: 1.13 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.13 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.13 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_772 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_772 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_772 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0772
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0772FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0772FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_knee(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0772Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=7, act_dim=3):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)

        return self.net(state)
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
```

```rust
pub struct ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0777Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_777: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0777Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_777: 27.00,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_777: 24.80,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_777: 19.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_777 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)

        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_777 | Invariant expr: 24.2 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("24.2 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("24.2 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_777 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_777 | Invariant expr: 2.32 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.32 - knee_angle");
```

```cpp
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

### CASE STUDY #0781: [PRECISION_MANUFACTURING] FAST_STEERING_MIRROR_PIEZO_LASER_CASE_0780
**Application Context**: We are building a control system in Shiva for piezoelectric tip-tilt fast steering mirror (FSM) for optical beam pointing and jitter cancellation. The plant uses multi-layer PZT stack actuators with capacitive displacement sensor feedback. We have telemetry measuring tilt_theta_x_urad, tilt_theta_y_urad, jitter_quadrant_px, jitter_quadrant_py via telemetry. We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands piezo_voltage_x (0.0 to 125.06 V), piezo_voltage_y (0.0 to 139.35 V). Critically, safety constraints require that cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_780 with invariant '141.98 - piezo_voltage_x' (gamma=55.2) and cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_780 with invariant 'piezo_voltage_x - 0.0' (gamma=57.2) and cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_780 with invariant '23.1 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)' (gamma=28.8). The loop must execute deterministically at 5000 Hz with a 1 ms watchdog lease.

```cpp
    void step() noexcept override {

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
```

```rust
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DelicateGripperForceCase0782Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_782: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_782: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0782Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_782: 26.20,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_782: 21.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_782 | Invariant expr: 5.62 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.62 - pinch_force");

        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0787
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0787Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_787: f64,
    gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_787: f64,
}

impl VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0787Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_787: 14.80,
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_787: 14.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_787 | Invariant expr: chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_787 });
        // CBF: cbf_chamber_max_burst_787 | Invariant expr: 57.17 - chamber_pressure_mtorr (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("57.17 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("57.17 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_787 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0790Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_790: f64,
    gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_790: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_790: f64,
}

impl FlywheelKineticUpsFrequencyCase0790Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_790: 29.40,
            gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_790: 39.90,
            gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_790: 27.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_790 | Invariant expr: 51305.96 - rotor_speed_rpm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("51305.96 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("51305.96 - rotor_speed_rpm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_burst_overspeed_centrifugal_790 });
        // CBF: cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_790 | Invariant expr: 66.16 - rotor_radial_runout_um (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("66.16 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("66.16 - rotor_radial_runout_um");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_magnetic_touchdown_bearing_gap_790 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_extraction_speed_790 | Invariant expr: rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_790 });
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for hexacopter_payload_drop_case_0795
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct HexacopterPayloadDropCase0795Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_795: f64,
    gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_795: f64,
}

impl HexacopterPayloadDropCase0795Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_795: 14.30,
            gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_795: 7.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sway_bound_795 | Invariant expr: 0.33 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.33 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.33 - sqrt(cable_sway_x^2 + cable_sway_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sway_bound_795 });
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_795 | Invariant expr: 197.4 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("197.4 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("197.4 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_795 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("air_pressure_bar - 4.8");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_802 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_802 | Invariant expr: 181465781.74 - pos_x_nm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("181465781.74 - pos_x_nm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("181465781.74 - pos_x_nm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_802 });
        // CBF: cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_802 | Invariant expr: pos_x_nm - (-181465781.74) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("pos_x_nm - (-181465781.74)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("pos_x_nm - (-181465781.74)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_802 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        }
```

```rust
pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0805Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_805: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_805: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_805: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0805Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_805: 19.30,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_805: 18.00,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_805: 12.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_805 | Invariant expr: 0.09 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_805 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_805 | Invariant expr: 0.05 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_805 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_805 | Invariant expr: 0.63 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.63 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.63 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_805 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
    explicit BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0805FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_810 | Invariant expr: 0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.13 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_810 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0813
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0813Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_813: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_813: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_813: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0813Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_813: 45.40,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_813: 52.10,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_813: 32.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_813 | Invariant expr: 146.24 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("146.24 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("146.24 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_813 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_813 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_813 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_813 | Invariant expr: 17.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("17.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("17.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_813 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0815
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0815Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_815: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_815: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_815: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0815Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_815: 20.60,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_815: 16.60,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_815: 11.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_815 | Invariant expr: 23.7 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.7 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.7 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_815 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_815 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_815 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_815 | Invariant expr: 2.47 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.47 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.47 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_815 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0815
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0815FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0815FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("36.69 - airspeed_mps");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("36.69 - airspeed_mps");
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for steam_boiler_drum_level_3element_case_0820
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0820Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_820: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_820: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_820: f64,
}

impl SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0820Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_820: 11.10,
            gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_820: 12.40,
            gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_820: 17.00,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_820 | Invariant expr: 242.27 - drum_level_mm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("242.27 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("242.27 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_820 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_820 | Invariant expr: drum_level_mm - (-200.52) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("drum_level_mm - (-200.52)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("drum_level_mm - (-200.52)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_820 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_820 | Invariant expr: 165.0 - drum_pressure_bar (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_820 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
    void step() noexcept override {
```

```cpp
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0827
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0827Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_827: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_827: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0827Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_827: 14.90,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_827: 7.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_827 | Invariant expr: 0.43 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.43 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.43 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_827 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_827 | Invariant expr: 5.09 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.09 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.09 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_827 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_sideslip_stability_envelope_830: 18.20,
            gamma_cbf_combined_inverter_thermal_830: 5.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_832 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_832 | Invariant expr: 20.7 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.7 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.7 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_832 });
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0835
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0835Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_835: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_835: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_835: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0835Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_835: 46.40,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_835: 45.70,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_835: 32.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_835 | Invariant expr: 145.89 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("145.89 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("145.89 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_835 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_835 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_835 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_835 | Invariant expr: 17.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("17.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("17.79 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_835 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_842: 12.80,
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0849
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0849Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_849: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_849: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_849: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0849Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_849: 17.20,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_849: 16.40,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_849: 25.60,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_849 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_849 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_849 | Invariant expr: 0.88 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.88 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_849 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_849 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_849 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0849

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);

        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
```

```rust
pub struct PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0854Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_854: f64,
}

impl PoweredTranstibialProsthesisCase0854Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_854: 18.90,
            gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_854: 19.70,
            gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_854: 17.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_anatomical_dorsiflexion_hardstop_854 | Invariant expr: 0.46 - ankle_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.46 - ankle_angle");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_anatomical_plantarflexion_hardstop_854 });
        // CBF: cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_854 | Invariant expr: 0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.17 - abs(sea_spring_deflection)");
```

### CASE STUDY #0860: [ROBOTICS_MANIPULATION] DELICATE_GRIPPER_FORCE_CASE_0859

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for delicate_gripper_force_case_0859
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DelicateGripperForceCase0859Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_859: f64,
    gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_859: f64,
}

impl DelicateGripperForceCase0859Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_859: 26.80,
            gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_859: 20.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_max_normal_force_859 | Invariant expr: 5.41 - pinch_force (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("5.41 - pinch_force");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("5.41 - pinch_force");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_normal_force_859 });
        // CBF: cbf_min_jaw_stroke_859 | Invariant expr: jaw_gap - 0.001 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("jaw_gap - 0.001");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_jaw_stroke_859 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        // CBF: cbf_geofence_cylinder_861 | Invariant expr: 160.42 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("160.42 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("160.42 - sqrt(pos_x^2 + pos_y^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_geofence_cylinder_861 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for inverted_pendulum_case_0869
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0869Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_869: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_869: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0869Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_869: 11.10,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_869: 13.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_869 | Invariant expr: 2.47 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.47 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.47 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_869 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_869 | Invariant expr: theta - (-1.86) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-1.86)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-1.86)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_869 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0871
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0871Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_871: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_871: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_871: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0871Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_871: 18.80,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_871: 20.00,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_871: 13.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_871 | Invariant expr: 0.12 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.12 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.12 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_871 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_871 | Invariant expr: 0.04 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.04 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.04 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_871 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_871 | Invariant expr: 0.67 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.67 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.67 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_871 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
class BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0871FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);

    }

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
```

```rust
pub struct LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0879Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_879: f64,
}

impl LinearStageAirBearingNanometerCase0879Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_879: 41.40,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_pos_x_879: 18.60,
            gamma_cbf_stage_optical_travel_limit_neg_x_879: 21.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_air_bearing_min_levitation_pressure_879 | Invariant expr: air_pressure_bar - 4.8 (Degree 1)
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0881
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0881Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_881: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_881: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_881: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0881Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_881: 18.30,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_881: 17.00,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_881: 12.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_881 | Invariant expr: 22.9 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("22.9 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("22.9 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_881 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_881 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_881 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_881 | Invariant expr: 2.43 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.43 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.43 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_881 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0881
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0881FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0881FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);

        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0883
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0883Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_883: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_883: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_883: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0883Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_883: 15.10,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_883: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_883: 9.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_883 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_883 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_883 | Invariant expr: 0.84 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.84 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.84 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_883 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_883 | Invariant expr: 41.46 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("41.46 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("41.46 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_883 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0883
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0883FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0883FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 4> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thrust_collective(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_roll(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_pitch(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau_yaw(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
pub struct DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0885Guardrail {

    gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_885: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_885: f64,
}

impl DriveByWireSteeringLaneCenteringCase0885Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_885: 9.60,
            gamma_cbf_max_lateral_acceleration_885: 15.60,
            gamma_cbf_pinion_angle_hardstop_885: 17.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_885 | Invariant expr: 0.7 - abs(lateral_error) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.7 - abs(lateral_error)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.7 - abs(lateral_error)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_lane_boundary_safe_envelope_885 });

    }
```

```cpp
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for double_pendulum_case_0891
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct DoublePendulumCase0891Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_891: f64,
    gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_891: f64,
}

impl DoublePendulumCase0891Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_891: 15.60,
            gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_891: 15.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_891 | Invariant expr: 1.96 - theta2 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.96 - theta2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.96 - theta2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_pos_891 });
        // CBF: cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_891 | Invariant expr: theta2 - (-2.57) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta2 - (-2.57)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta2 - (-2.57)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_elbow_hyper_neg_891 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0893
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0893Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_893: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_893: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_893: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0893Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_893: 17.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_893: 15.30,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_893: 21.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_893 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_893 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_893 | Invariant expr: 0.85 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_893 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_893 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_893 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0895
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CubesatReactionWheelCase0895Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_895: f64,
    gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_895: f64,
}

impl CubesatReactionWheelCase0895Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_895: 10.90,
            gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_895: 14.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_rw_speed_saturation_895 | Invariant expr: 6965.61 - abs(rw_speed_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("6965.61 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("6965.61 - abs(rw_speed_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_rw_speed_saturation_895 });
        // CBF: cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_895 | Invariant expr: sun_payload_angle - 0.785 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("sun_payload_angle - 0.785");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_payload_sun_exclusion_895 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```
