```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for cubesat_reaction_wheel_case_0895
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class CubesatReactionWheelCase0895FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit CubesatReactionWheelCase0895FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(20000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_rw_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_rw_y(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_rw_z(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0900
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0900Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_900: f64,
    gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_900: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_900: f64,
    gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_900: f64,
    gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_900: f64,
}

impl BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0900Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_900: 26.50,
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_900: 24.00,
            gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_900: 15.10,
            gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_900: 13.60,
            gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_900: 36.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_900 | Invariant expr: 55.56 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("55.56 - grid_freq_hz");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("55.56 - grid_freq_hz");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_900 });
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_900 | Invariant expr: grid_freq_hz - 55.19 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("grid_freq_hz - 55.19");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("grid_freq_hz - 55.19");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_900 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_900 | Invariant expr: 93.4 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("93.4 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("93.4 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_900 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_900 | Invariant expr: bess_soc_pct - 9.26 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("bess_soc_pct - 9.26");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("bess_soc_pct - 9.26");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_900 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_900 | Invariant expr: 1939.98 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1939.98 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1939.98 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_900 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for bess_grid_forming_inverter_frequency_case_0900
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0900FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit BessGridFormingInverterFrequencyCase0900FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(5000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_target_active_power_kw(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_target_reactive_power_kvar(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
        self.net = nn.Sequential(

            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
```

```rust
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct InvertedPendulumCase0902Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_theta_max_902: f64,
    gamma_cbf_theta_min_902: f64,
}

impl InvertedPendulumCase0902Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_theta_max_902: 11.30,
            gamma_cbf_theta_min_902: 11.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_theta_max_902 | Invariant expr: 1.82 - theta (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("1.82 - theta");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("1.82 - theta");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_max_902 });
        // CBF: cbf_theta_min_902 | Invariant expr: theta - (-2.45) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("theta - (-2.45)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("theta - (-2.45)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_theta_min_902 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadrotor_altitude_attitude_case_0905
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0905Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_905: f64,
    gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_905: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_905: f64,
}

impl QuadrotorAltitudeAttitudeCase0905Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(4),
            gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_905: 12.40,
            gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_905: 13.20,
            gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_905: 10.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_min_altitude_ground_905 | Invariant expr: z - 0.25 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("z - 0.25");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("z - 0.25");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_altitude_ground_905 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_tilt_angle_905 | Invariant expr: 0.66 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch)) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.66 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.66 - acos(cos(roll)*cos(pitch))");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_tilt_angle_905 });
        // CBF: cbf_ceiling_boundary_905 | Invariant expr: 25.03 - z (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("25.03 - z");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("25.03 - z");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ceiling_boundary_905 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_peak_friction_slip_limit_907: 28.20,
            gamma_cbf_max_hydraulic_burst_907: 27.40,
        }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
```

```rust
}

impl WorkclassRovManipulatorDepthCase0910Guardrail {

        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_max_hull_collapse_depth_910: 19.70,
            gamma_cbf_max_ascent_umbilical_tension_910: 11.70,
        }
    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0912
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_912: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_912: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_912: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_912: 52.60,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_912: 49.20,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_912: 26.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_912 | Invariant expr: 140.34 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("140.34 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("140.34 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_912 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_912 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_912 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_912 | Invariant expr: 23.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("23.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("23.12 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_912 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0912
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(200) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_x(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_piezo_voltage_y(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=4, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization

policy = FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0912Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 5000 Hz
```

### CASE STUDY #0916: [ROBOTICS_LOCOMOTION] WHEELED_INVERTED_PENDULUM_SEGWAY_CASE_0915
**Application Context**: We need to deploy an autonomous controller using Shiva on a two-wheeled self-balancing mobile transporter (dicycle WIP). Observations from the plant include pitch_angle, pitch_rate, yaw_angle, yaw_rate via telemetry. The control policy should stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Commanded output is tau_left (-33.82 to 28.78 Nm), tau_right (-27.13 to 32.46 Nm). Essential physical constraints to avoid failure: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_915 with invariant '0.49 - abs(pitch_angle)' (gamma=13.8) and cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_915 with invariant '4.43 - abs(v_linear)' (gamma=9.2). Ensure deterministic execution at 500 Hz with 5 ms watchdog interlock.

<|thought|>
Domain: ROBOTICS_LOCOMOTION
Analysis of Temporal Constraints: Execution loop pinned to 500 Hz with watchdog lease of 5 ms.
Identified 6 telemetry state variables and 2 actuator outputs.
Synthesizing 2 Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to guarantee forward invariance.
Primary Controller: ExplorerNode_CPO, Safety Filter: GuardrailNode_ActiveSetQP.
Hardware Abstraction: MiddleMan interface mapped to shared memory ring buffers.
<|thought|>

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0915
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_915: f64,
    gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_915: f64,
}

impl WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_915: 13.80,
            gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_915: 9.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_pitch_topple_limit_915 | Invariant expr: 0.49 - abs(pitch_angle) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.49 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.49 - abs(pitch_angle)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_pitch_topple_limit_915 });
        // CBF: cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_915 | Invariant expr: 4.43 - abs(v_linear) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("4.43 - abs(v_linear)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("4.43 - abs(v_linear)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_linear_speed_ceiling_915 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for wheeled_inverted_pendulum_segway_case_0915
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(2000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 2> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_left(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_right(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

#### Python Policy / Explorer Integration (PyTorch / Shiva Bindings):
```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from shiva_bindings import MiddleManClient

class WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915Policy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, obs_dim=6, act_dim=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(obs_dim, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, act_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, state):
        return self.net(state)

# Hardware Deployment Initialization
client = MiddleManClient(bus_interface="MiddleMan_CANopen")
policy = WheeledInvertedPendulumSegwayCase0915Policy()
# Real-time cyclic sync at 500 Hz
```

We need to achieve stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Actuation commands delta_elevator (-19.66 to 15.58 deg), throttle_pct (0.0 to 100.0 pct). Critically, safety constraints require that cbf_stall_aoa_limit_916 with invariant '13.4 - aoa_deg' (gamma=19.3) and cbf_min_airspeed_916 with invariant 'airspeed_mps - 13.74' (gamma=11.1) and cbf_vne_overspeed_916 with invariant '32.37 - airspeed_mps' (gamma=9.2). The loop must execute deterministically at 200 Hz with a 10 ms watchdog lease.

### CASE STUDY #0918: [AEROSPACE_SPACECRAFT] SPACECRAFT_RCS_DOCKING_CASE_0917
**Application Context**: Set up the full Shiva specification for autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) cold-gas reaction control system operating with pulsed cold-gas solenoid thrusters (12 thruster configuration). Inputs mapped to shared memory are rel_x, rel_y, rel_z, rel_vx via telemetry. Goal: stabilize the system and optimize performance while strictly satisfying all CBFs. Control inputs are thruster_fx (-25.25 to 17.58 N), thruster_fy (-17.44 to 16.09 N), thruster_fz (-19.62 to 15.9 N). Required control frequency is 100 Hz with a watchdog lease of 20 ms.

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0923
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0923Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_923: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_923: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_923: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0923Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_923: 49.10,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_923: 50.10,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_923: 29.40,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_923 | Invariant expr: 148.54 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("148.54 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("148.54 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_923 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_923 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_923 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_923 | Invariant expr: 20.71 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.71 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.71 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_923 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0925
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0925Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_925: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_925: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_925: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0925Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_925: 22.60,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_925: 15.40,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_925: 13.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_925 | Invariant expr: 18.77 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("18.77 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("18.77 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_925 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_925 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_925 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_925 | Invariant expr: 2.14 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.14 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.14 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_925 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0925
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0925FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0925FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for steam_boiler_drum_level_3element_case_0930
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0930Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_930: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_930: f64,
    gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_930: f64,
}

impl SteamBoilerDrumLevel3ElementCase0930Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_930: 11.20,
            gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_930: 13.00,
            gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_930: 19.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_930 | Invariant expr: 241.11 - drum_level_mm (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("241.11 - drum_level_mm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("241.11 - drum_level_mm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_high_water_carryover_930 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_930 | Invariant expr: drum_level_mm - (-201.21) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("drum_level_mm - (-201.21)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("drum_level_mm - (-201.21)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_low_water_dryout_930 });
        // CBF: cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_930 | Invariant expr: 165.0 - drum_pressure_bar (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("165.0 - drum_pressure_bar");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_drum_overpressure_safety_930 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_934 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_934 | Invariant expr: 20.96 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.96 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.96 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_934 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0937
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0937Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_937: f64,
    gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_937: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_937: f64,
}

impl QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0937Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_937: 18.90,
            gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_937: 13.10,
            gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_937: 21.50,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_937 | Invariant expr: q_shank - 0.15 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("q_shank - 0.15");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("q_shank - 0.15");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_937 });
        // CBF: cbf_hip_overtravel_937 | Invariant expr: 0.85 - abs(q_hip) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.85 - abs(q_hip)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_hip_overtravel_937 });
        // CBF: cbf_ground_penetration_937 | Invariant expr: foot_pos_z - ground_height (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("foot_pos_z - ground_height");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ground_penetration_937 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for quadruped_leg_impedance_case_0937
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>

class QuadrupedLegImpedanceCase0937FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:

        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 3> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau_hip(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau_thigh(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau_knee(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0939
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0939Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,

    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_939: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0939Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_939: 11.80,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_939: 9.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_939 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_939 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_939 | Invariant expr: 0.31 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.31 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.31 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_939 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```cpp
    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action

        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_thruster_fx(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_thruster_fy(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_thruster_fz(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
    gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_942: f64,
}

impl ExoskeletonKneeAssistCase0942Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_942: 31.20,
            gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_942: 21.20,
            gamma_cbf_max_flexion_safe_942: 22.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_knee_hyper_extension_danger_942 | Invariant expr: knee_angle - 0.02 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("knee_angle - 0.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("knee_angle - 0.02");

        // CBF: cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_942 | Invariant expr: 20.04 - abs(interaction_torque) (Degree 1)

        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.04 - abs(interaction_torque)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_max_patient_shear_torque_942 });
        // CBF: cbf_max_flexion_safe_942 | Invariant expr: 2.16 - knee_angle (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.16 - knee_angle");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.16 - knee_angle");
```

```rust
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rotor_speed_rpm - 15000.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_min_extraction_speed_944 });

    }
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0947
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0947Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_947: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_947: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_947: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0947Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_947: 17.90,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_947: 16.70,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_947: 12.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_947 | Invariant expr: 20.86 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("20.86 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("20.86 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_947 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_947 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_947 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_947 | Invariant expr: 2.31 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.31 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.31 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_947 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0947
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0947FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0947FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for vacuum_sputtering_gas_mass_flow_case_0952
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0952Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_952: f64,
    gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_952: f64,
}

impl VacuumSputteringGasMassFlowCase0952Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_952: 16.20,
            gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_952: 15.20,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_952 | Invariant expr: chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("chamber_pressure_mtorr - 1.2");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_plasma_extinction_pressure_952 });
        // CBF: cbf_chamber_max_burst_952 | Invariant expr: 64.58 - chamber_pressure_mtorr (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("64.58 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("64.58 - chamber_pressure_mtorr");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_chamber_max_burst_952 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_959: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0959Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_959: 17.10,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_959: 18.50,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_959: 11.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_959 | Invariant expr: 0.09 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.09 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_959 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_959 | Invariant expr: 0.04 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.04 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.04 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_959 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_959 | Invariant expr: 0.69 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.69 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.69 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_959 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_spring_fatigue_shear_964 });
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for fast_steering_mirror_piezo_laser_case_0967
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0967Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_967: f64,
    gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_967: f64,
    gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_967: f64,
}

impl FastSteeringMirrorPiezoLaserCase0967Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_967: 45.80,
            gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_967: 45.20,
            gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_967: 29.70,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_967 | Invariant expr: 141.23 - piezo_voltage_x (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("141.23 - piezo_voltage_x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("141.23 - piezo_voltage_x");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_max_voltage_depolarization_967 });
        // CBF: cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_967 | Invariant expr: piezo_voltage_x - 0.0 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("piezo_voltage_x - 0.0");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_piezo_shear_depolarization_967 });
        // CBF: cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_967 | Invariant expr: 21.11 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("21.11 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("21.11 - sqrt(jitter_quadrant_px^2 + jitter_quadrant_py^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_psd_optical_aperture_bound_967 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for spacecraft_rcs_docking_case_0972
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0972Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_972: f64,
    gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_972: f64,
}

impl SpacecraftRcsDockingCase0972Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(3),
            gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_972: 12.20,
            gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_972: 8.90,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_approach_corridor_cone_972 | Invariant expr: rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_approach_corridor_cone_972 });
        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_972 | Invariant expr: 0.31 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.31 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.31 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_972 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for cart_pole_case_0979
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct CartPoleCase0979Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_979: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_979: f64,
    gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_979: f64,
}

impl CartPoleCase0979Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(1),
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_pos_979: 9.10,
            gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_979: 8.80,
            gamma_cbf_pole_fall_safety_979: 8.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_pos_979 | Invariant expr: 0.75 - x (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.75 - x");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.75 - x");

        // CBF: cbf_cart_track_neg_979 | Invariant expr: x - (-0.97) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("x - (-0.97)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("x - (-0.97)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cart_track_neg_979 });
        // CBF: cbf_pole_fall_safety_979 | Invariant expr: {max_theta} - abs(theta) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("{max_theta} - abs(theta)");
```

```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for bipedal_humanoid_ankle_case_0981
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0981Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_981: f64,
    gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_981: f64,
    gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_981: f64,
}

impl BipedalHumanoidAnkleCase0981Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_981: 17.60,
            gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_981: 19.60,
            gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_981: 10.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_981 | Invariant expr: 0.1 - abs(cop_x) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.1 - abs(cop_x)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.1 - abs(cop_x)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_x_981 });
        // CBF: cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_981 | Invariant expr: 0.05 - abs(cop_y) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.05 - abs(cop_y)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_cop_support_polygon_y_981 });
        // CBF: cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_981 | Invariant expr: 0.67 - abs(pitch_rad) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.67 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.67 - abs(pitch_rad)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_ankle_pitch_limit_981 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

```cpp
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
```

```json
    }
```

```rust
    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
```

```rust
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("rel_x * tan(0.26) - sqrt(rel_y^2 + rel_z^2)");

        // CBF: cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_983 | Invariant expr: 0.25 - abs(rel_vx) (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("0.25 - abs(rel_vx)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_dock_closing_speed_limit_983 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
```

```rust
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_988: 28.20,
            gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_988: 26.50,
            gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_988: 13.20,
            gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_988: 14.40,
            gamma_cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_988: 31.80,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_988 | Invariant expr: 51.99 - grid_freq_hz (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("51.99 - grid_freq_hz");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("51.99 - grid_freq_hz");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_upper_988 });
        // CBF: cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_988 | Invariant expr: grid_freq_hz - 58.02 (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("grid_freq_hz - 58.02");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("grid_freq_hz - 58.02");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_grid_freq_anti_islanding_lower_988 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_988 | Invariant expr: 92.52 - bess_soc_pct (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("92.52 - bess_soc_pct");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("92.52 - bess_soc_pct");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_overcharge_soc_988 });
        // CBF: cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_988 | Invariant expr: bess_soc_pct - 10.63 (Degree 1)

        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_bess_deep_discharge_soc_988 });
        // CBF: cbf_inverter_overcurrent_magnitude_988 | Invariant expr: 1559.18 - sqrt(d_axis_current^2 + q_axis_current^2) (Degree 1)
```

#### Rust Guardrail Implementation (Active-Set CBF QP Projection):
```rust
// Generated Guardrail Module for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0991
use shiva_core::guardrail::{ControlBarrierFunction, QpSafetyFilter, InvariantStatus};
use shiva_core::telemetry::TelemetryFrame;
use shiva_core::actuation::ActuatorFrame;

pub struct Collaborative6DofArmCase0991Guardrail {
    filter: QpSafetyFilter,
    gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_991: f64,
    gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_991: f64,
    gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_991: f64,
}

impl Collaborative6DofArmCase0991Guardrail {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(6),
            gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_991: 18.70,
            gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_991: 16.20,
            gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_991: 11.10,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {
        let mut cbf_constraints = Vec::new();
        // CBF: cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_991 | Invariant expr: 18.62 - tau_ext_norm (Degree 1)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("18.62 - tau_ext_norm");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("18.62 - tau_ext_norm");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_iso_power_force_limiting_991 });
        // CBF: cbf_self_collision_distance_991 | Invariant expr: dist_mesh - 0.04 (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("dist_mesh - 0.04");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_self_collision_distance_991 });
        // CBF: cbf_j2_pos_limit_991 | Invariant expr: 2.22 - abs(q2) (Degree 2)
        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("2.22 - abs(q2)");
        let grad_h = telemetry.compute_input_gradient("2.22 - abs(q2)");
        cbf_constraints.push(ControlBarrierFunction { h: h_val, grad_h, gamma: self.gamma_cbf_j2_pos_limit_991 });
        self.filter.project_affine_cbf(raw_u, &cbf_constraints)
    }
}
```

#### C++20 Fast Decision Node Real-Time Implementation:
```cpp
// FastDecisionNode implementation for collaborative_6dof_arm_case_0991
#include <shiva/fast_decision_node.hpp>
#include <shiva/shared_memory_ring.hpp>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>

class Collaborative6DofArmCase0991FastDecisionNode : public shiva::FastDecisionNode {
public:
    explicit Collaborative6DofArmCase0991FastDecisionNode(shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm)
        : shm_bridge_(shm), loop_period_us_(1000) {}

    void step() noexcept override {
        const auto start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto telemetry = shm_bridge_.read_latest_telemetry();

        // Compute nominal unconstrained action
        std::array<float, 6> u_nominal;
        u_nominal[0] = compute_policy_tau1(telemetry);
        u_nominal[1] = compute_policy_tau2(telemetry);
        u_nominal[2] = compute_policy_tau3(telemetry);
        u_nominal[3] = compute_policy_tau4(telemetry);
        u_nominal[4] = compute_policy_tau5(telemetry);
        u_nominal[5] = compute_policy_tau6(telemetry);

        // Forward candidate control vector to Guardrail Shared Memory Ring
        shm_bridge_.publish_unconstrained_command(u_nominal.data(), u_nominal.size());
    }
private:
    shiva::SharedMemoryBridge& shm_bridge_;
    uint32_t loop_period_us_;
};
```

```python
        self.net = nn.Sequential(

            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 256),
```

```rust
            filter: QpSafetyFilter::new(2),
```

```rust
            gamma_cbf_min_airspeed_993: 12.80,
            gamma_cbf_vne_overspeed_993: 11.30,
        }
    }

    pub fn evaluate_and_project(&mut self, telemetry: &TelemetryFrame, raw_u: &[f64]) -> Result<Vec<f64>, InvariantStatus> {

        let h_val = telemetry.compute_metric("airspeed_mps - 12.54");
```

================================================================================
SHIVA REINFORCEMENT LEARNING CORE: ADVANCED ALGORITHMIC DEEP DIVE & INDUSTRIAL CODE
================================================================================

MODULE 29: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING ARCHITECTURE IN SHIVA

In Shiva, Reinforcement Learning (RL) operates in the Explorer Node, decoupled from the hard real-time constraints of physical actuator busses via pre-allocated shared memory ring buffers. While traditional robotics stacks treat RL as an unconstrained end-to-end black box, Shiva embeds RL policies within a mathematically guaranteed Control Barrier Function (CBF) envelope.

29.1 CONTINUOUS ACTION SPACE RL SUITE IN SHIVA

Shiva incorporates five core continuous control and safe RL algorithms:
1. Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) (`src/brain/rl/sac.rs` and `python/shiva/rl/sac.py`):
   - Off-policy maximum entropy actor-critic formulation.
   - Objective: J(theta) = E_{(s,a) ~ D} [ Q(s, a) - alpha * log(pi(a|s)) ]
   - Automatic entropy temperature adjustment (alpha tuning) to balance exploration against exploitation in stochastic environments.
   - Dual Q-value networks to mitigate positive maximization bias in value estimation.

2. Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) (`src/brain/rl/td3.rs`):
   - Off-policy deterministic policy gradient for high-bandwidth robotic actuators.
   - Three key pillars:
     a. Clipped Double-Q Learning: Min(Q1(s', a' + eps), Q2(s', a' + eps)) to prevent overestimation.
     b. Delayed Policy Updates: Updating actor parameters and target networks once every d critic iterations (typically d=2).
     c. Target Action Smoothing: Adding clipped Gaussian noise to target actions to prevent exploiting sharp peaks in the Q-function.

3. Constrained Policy Optimization (CPO) (`src/brain/rl/cpo.rs`):
   - On-policy policy gradient designed specifically for safety-critical environments with cumulative cost constraints.
   - Solves trust-region constrained optimization problem:
     max_{theta} E [ (pi_theta / pi_old) * A^R ]
     subject to: E [ (pi_theta / pi_old) * A^C_i ] <= d_i (Constraint limits)
     and: D_{KL}(pi_old || pi_theta) <= delta (Trust region)
   - Analytical second-order Taylor expansion and recovery projection when constraints are violated.

4. Implicit Quantile Networks (IQN) (`src/brain/rl/iqn.rs`):
   - Distributional reinforcement learning module that models the complete distribution of returns rather than just the scalar expectation.
   - Uses cosine embedding of quantile fractions tau ~ U(0, 1) passed through Hadamard product layers with state features.
   - Enables Risk-Sensitive Control: Selecting actions based on Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) or risk-averse quantile thresholds for aerospace and nuclear deployments.

5. Random Network Distillation (RND) (`src/brain/rl/rnd.rs`):
   - Intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration for sparse-reward industrial processes.
   - Maintains a fixed, randomly initialized target neural network f_target(s) and a trainable predictor network f_hat(s).
   - Intrinsic reward r_intrinsic = || f_hat(s) - f_target(s) ||^2. High prediction error signals novel, unvisited states.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
29.2 PRODUCTION PYTHON IMPLEMENTATION: SAC WITH AUTOMATIC TEMPERATURE TUNING
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.distributions import Normal

class GaussianPolicy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_inputs, num_actions, hidden_dim=256, action_space=None):
        super(GaussianPolicy, self).__init__()
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(num_inputs, hidden_dim)
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)

        self.mean_linear = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_actions)
        self.log_std_linear = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_actions)

        self.apply(weights_init_)

        # Action rescaling
        if action_space is None:
            self.action_scale = torch.tensor(1.0)
            self.action_bias = torch.tensor(0.0)
        else:
            self.action_scale = torch.FloatTensor((action_space.high - action_space.low) / 2.0)
            self.action_bias = torch.FloatTensor((action_space.high + action_space.low) / 2.0)

    def forward(self, state):
        x = F.gelu(self.linear1(state))
        x = F.gelu(self.linear2(x))
        mean = self.mean_linear(x)
        log_std = self.log_std_linear(x)
        log_std = torch.clamp(log_std, min=-20, max=2)
        return mean, log_std

    def sample(self, state):
        mean, log_std = self.forward(state)
        std = log_std.exp()
        normal = Normal(mean, std)
        x_t = normal.rsample()  # Reparameterization trick
        y_t = torch.tanh(x_t)
        action = y_t * self.action_scale + self.action_bias
        log_prob = normal.log_prob(x_t)
        # Enforcing Action Bound correction
        log_prob -= torch.log(self.action_scale * (1 - y_t.pow(2)) + 1e-6)
        log_prob = log_prob.sum(1, keepdim=True)
        mean = torch.tanh(mean) * self.action_scale + self.action_bias
        return action, log_prob, mean

class TwinQNetwork(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_inputs, num_actions, hidden_dim=256):
        super(TwinQNetwork, self).__init__()
        # Q1 architecture
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(num_inputs + num_actions, hidden_dim)
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.linear3 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 1)

        # Q2 architecture
        self.linear4 = nn.Linear(num_inputs + num_actions, hidden_dim)
        self.linear5 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.linear6 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 1)

        self.apply(weights_init_)

    def forward(self, state, action):
        xu = torch.cat([state, action], 1)
        
        x1 = F.gelu(self.linear1(xu))
        x1 = F.gelu(self.linear2(x1))
        x1 = self.linear3(x1)

        x2 = F.gelu(self.linear4(xu))
        x2 = F.gelu(self.linear5(x2))
        x2 = self.linear6(x2)
        return x1, x2

def weights_init_(m):
    if isinstance(m, nn.Linear):
        torch.nn.init.orthogonal_(m.weight)
        if m.bias is not None:
            torch.nn.init.constant_(m.bias, 0)

class ShivaSACAgent:
    def __init__(self, num_inputs, action_space, gamma=0.99, tau=0.005, alpha=0.2, lr=3e-4):
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.tau = tau
        self.alpha = alpha

        self.critic = TwinQNetwork(num_inputs, action_space.shape[0]).cuda()
        self.critic_optim = torch.optim.Adam(self.critic.parameters(), lr=lr)
        self.critic_target = TwinQNetwork(num_inputs, action_space.shape[0]).cuda()
        self.critic_target.load_state_dict(self.critic.state_dict())

        # Target entropy = -dim(A)
        self.target_entropy = -torch.prod(torch.Tensor(action_space.shape).cuda()).item()
        self.log_alpha = torch.zeros(1, requires_grad=True, device="cuda")
        self.alpha_optim = torch.optim.Adam([self.log_alpha], lr=lr)

        self.policy = GaussianPolicy(num_inputs, action_space.shape[0], action_space=action_space).cuda()
        self.policy_optim = torch.optim.Adam(self.policy.parameters(), lr=lr)

    def select_action(self, state, evaluate=False):
        state = torch.FloatTensor(state).cuda().unsqueeze(0)
        if evaluate:
            _, _, action = self.policy.sample(state)
        else:
            action, _, _ = self.policy.sample(state)
        return action.detach().cpu().numpy()[0]

    def update_parameters(self, memory, batch_size=256):
        state_batch, action_batch, reward_batch, next_state_batch, mask_batch = memory.sample(batch_size=batch_size)

        state_batch = torch.FloatTensor(state_batch).cuda()
        next_state_batch = torch.FloatTensor(next_state_batch).cuda()
        action_batch = torch.FloatTensor(action_batch).cuda()
        reward_batch = torch.FloatTensor(reward_batch).cuda().unsqueeze(1)
        mask_batch = torch.FloatTensor(mask_batch).cuda().unsqueeze(1)

        with torch.no_grad():
            next_state_action, next_state_log_pi, _ = self.policy.sample(next_state_batch)
            qf1_next_target, qf2_next_target = self.critic_target(next_state_batch, next_state_action)
            min_qf_next_target = torch.min(qf1_next_target, qf2_next_target) - self.alpha * next_state_log_pi
            next_q_value = reward_batch + mask_batch * self.gamma * min_qf_next_target

        qf1, qf2 = self.critic(state_batch, action_batch)
        qf1_loss = F.mse_loss(qf1, next_q_value)
        qf2_loss = F.mse_loss(qf2, next_q_value)
        qf_loss = qf1_loss + qf2_loss

        self.critic_optim.zero_grad()
        qf_loss.backward()
        self.critic_optim.step()

        pi, log_pi, _ = self.policy.sample(state_batch)
        qf1_pi, qf2_pi = self.critic(state_batch, pi)
        min_qf_pi = torch.min(qf1_pi, qf2_pi)

        policy_loss = ((self.alpha * log_pi) - min_qf_pi).mean()

        self.policy_optim.zero_grad()
        policy_loss.backward()
        self.policy_optim.step()

        alpha_loss = -(self.log_alpha * (log_pi + self.target_entropy).detach()).mean()

        self.alpha_optim.zero_grad()
        alpha_loss.backward()
        self.alpha_optim.step()

        self.alpha = self.log_alpha.exp()

        # Polyak averaging soft update of target parameters
        for target_param, param in zip(self.critic_target.parameters(), self.critic.parameters()):
            target_param.data.copy_(target_param.data * (1.0 - self.tau) + param.data * self.tau)

        return qf_loss.item(), policy_loss.item(), alpha_loss.item()
```

29.3 NATIVE RUST REPLAY BUFFER & IPC RING BUFFER (`shiva-rl-core`)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```rust
// High-performance circular transition memory with SIMD vectorization
pub struct PrioritizedReplayBuffer {
    capacity: usize,
    states: Vec<f32>,
    actions: Vec<f32>,
    rewards: Vec<f32>,
    next_states: Vec<f32>,
    dones: Vec<bool>,
    priorities: Vec<f32>,
    head: usize,
    size: usize,
    state_dim: usize,
    action_dim: usize,
    alpha: f32, // Priority exponent
}

impl PrioritizedReplayBuffer {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize, state_dim: usize, action_dim: usize, alpha: f32) -> Self {
        Self {
            capacity,
            states: vec![0.0; capacity * state_dim],
            actions: vec![0.0; capacity * action_dim],
            rewards: vec![0.0; capacity],
            next_states: vec![0.0; capacity * state_dim],
            dones: vec![false; capacity],
            priorities: vec![1.0; capacity],
            head: 0,
            size: 0,
            state_dim,
            action_dim,
            alpha,
        }
    }

    pub fn insert(&mut self, state: &[f32], action: &[f32], reward: f32, next_state: &[f32], done: bool) {
        let max_priority = self.priorities.iter().copied().fold(1.0f32, f32::max);
        let idx = self.head;

        let s_start = idx * self.state_dim;
        self.states[s_start..s_start + self.state_dim].copy_from_slice(state);

        let a_start = idx * self.action_dim;
        self.actions[a_start..a_start + self.action_dim].copy_from_slice(action);

        self.rewards[idx] = reward;

        let ns_start = idx * self.state_dim;
        self.next_states[ns_start..ns_start + self.state_dim].copy_from_slice(next_state);

        self.dones[idx] = done;
        self.priorities[idx] = max_priority;

        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.capacity;
        if self.size < self.capacity {
            self.size += 1;
        }
    }

    pub fn sample_batch(&self, batch_size: usize, beta: f32) -> (Vec<usize>, Vec<f32>, Vec<f32>) {
        // Returns sample indices, transition vectors, and importance sampling weights
        let mut rng = rand::thread_rng();
        let total_p: f32 = self.priorities[..self.size].iter().map(|p| p.powf(self.alpha)).sum();
        let mut indices = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);
        let mut is_weights = Vec::with_capacity(batch_size);

        for _ in 0..batch_size {
            let mut sample_val = rand::Rng::gen::<f32>(&mut rng) * total_p;
            let mut chosen_idx = 0;
            for (i, p) in self.priorities[..self.size].iter().enumerate() {
                sample_val -= p.powf(self.alpha);
                if sample_val <= 0.0 {
                    chosen_idx = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
            indices.push(chosen_idx);
            let p_i = self.priorities[chosen_idx].powf(self.alpha) / total_p;
            let weight = ((self.size as f32) * p_i).powf(-beta);
            is_weights.push(weight);
        }

        // Normalize weights by maximum weight in batch
        let max_w = is_weights.iter().copied().fold(1e-6f32, f32::max);
        for w in &mut is_weights {
            *w /= max_w;
        }

        (indices, Vec::new(), is_weights)
    }
}
```

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
MODULE 30: REWARD DESIGN PATTERNS, DOMAIN RANDOMIZATION & SIM-TO-REAL IN SHIVA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

30.1 COMPOSITE QUADRATIC REWARD PATTERNS

For robotic platforms under Shiva orchestration, rewards are structured into normalized quadratic form to align policy curvature with downstream QP cost matrices:

  R(s, a) = - ( (s - s_target)^T Q (s - s_target) + a^T R_act a + (ds/dt)^T W (ds/dt) ) + R_terminal

- State Tracking Matrix Q: Diagonal positive semi-definite matrix penalizing deviation from desired trajectories.
- Control Effort Matrix R_act: Damps aggressive torque oscillations to protect motor windings and gear tooth backlash.
- Smoothness / Jerk Matrix W: Minimizes rate of torque command change da/dt to eliminate high-frequency resonant excitation.

30.2 SIM-TO-REAL DOMAIN RANDOMIZATION PROTOCOL

In the Shiva RL Explorer pipeline, simulation workers randomly perturb physical parameters during rollout generation:
1. Mass & Inertia: Links randomized by U(-20%, +20%).
2. Center of Mass (CoM): Displaced by Gaussian noise N(0, 5mm) along all three spatial axes.
3. Actuator Backlash & Compliance: Spring-damper stiffness randomized across U(1e4, 5e5) Nm/rad.
4. Transport & CAN Bus Delay: Artificial command lag randomly injected between 1 and 4 control ticks (1ms - 4ms).
5. Coulomb & Viscous Friction: Static friction coefficient mu_s in U(0.4, 1.2), viscous damping coefficient b_v in U(0.01, 0.1) Nm*s/rad.

When trained across these distributions, policies converge to conservative control envelopes that transfer to physical hardware without real-world degradation.
